title: Junior Payroll Assistant
description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate across 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Mission of the role To ensure the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of payroll for multiple UK clients. The UK Payroll Executive will be responsible for managing payroll data, processing payroll transactions, supporting workplace pension auto-enrolment, responding to client queries, and ensuring all payroll activities are completed in line with UK labour laws, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and agreed client timelines.

The role requires strong attention to detail, client service, ownership, and the ability to manage multiple payrolls and deadlines efficiently while continuously looking for ways to improve workflows through technology, AI, and automation.

Key outcomes In the first 6â12 monthsOutcome 1: UK Payroll Knowledge & Process Proficiency Develop a strong foundational understanding of UK payroll regulations and processes and confidently apply the appropriate rules when preparing and processing client payrolls.

Become fully familiar with Sleek's internal payroll platforms and processes, including HMRC submissions such as RTI, FPS and EPS, workplace pension submissions, and year-end reporting requirements including P60s and P11Ds by the third month.

Outcome 2: Accurate & Compliant Payroll Processing Process assigned client payrolls accurately and within agreed timelines, ensuring all payroll data is complete and correctly validated before submission.

Ensure 100% compliance with agreed payroll and statutory deadlines, including payroll runs, pension auto-enrolment submissions, and applicable HMRC requirements.

Identify discrepancies or potential issues early, take ownership of resolving them, and maintain high standards of confidentiality and data accuracy.

Outcome 3: Client Service & Responsiveness Maintain a high level of client satisfaction by providing prompt, accurate, and professional responses to payroll-related queries.

Consistently achieve a CSAT target of at least 97% month-on-month while ensuring that client queries and emails are responded to within the agreed communication SLA, with no non-reply tickets or emails left unresolved at the end of the working day.

Build trusted relationships with clients by providing clear updates, proactively following up on outstanding information, and handling difficult conversations positively when required.

Outcome 4: Team Collaboration & Process Improvement Work effectively with the UK Payroll team and other internal departments to ensure smooth payroll operations and timely resolution of client or processing issues.

Contribute to improving payroll processes and operational efficiency by identifying opportunities to use AI, automation, payroll technology, and improved workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase turnaround times.

Must-have experience

- Minimum 1â2 years of hands-on UK payroll processing experience.
- Experience working in a bureau, outsourced payroll environment, or shared services centre is preferred.
- Experience managing multiple client payroll accounts is an advantage.
- Working knowledge of UK payroll processes, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and workplace pension processes.
- Experience with payroll software such as BrightPay, Xero Payroll, or similar is an advantage.
- Strong attention to detail and experience working with sensitive and confidential financial information.
- Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.
- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
- Comfortable working with data and payroll-related reporting and metrics.
- Practical experience or strong interest in using AI tools, automation, and IT applications to improve daily workflows.
Must-have attributes

Ownership & Accountability: Takes full responsibility for assigned payrolls and client accounts, follows through on tasks without constant supervision, and proactively resolves issues or roadblocks.

Humility: Open to feedback, willing to learn, and comfortable acknowledging knowledge gaps and seeking support when required.

Structured Thinking: Able to organise multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and tasks in a clear and logical manner, while using sound judgement to prioritise competing requirements.

Data Driven & Attention to Detail: Comfortable working with numbers and payroll data, with a strong focus on accuracy. Able to identify discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies before they impact payroll processing or clients.

Can Have Tough Conversations in a Positive Way: Able to communicate clearly and professionally when dealing with sensitive payroll issues, missing information, delays, or difficult client situations while maintaining a constructive client relationship.

AI & Tech Savvy: Energetic about adopting new software, AI tools, automation, and technology to make payroll processes more efficient and effective.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

We will be looking for candidates who have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self-awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Attention to detail: You'll be managing multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and workstreams. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing, inconsistent, or likely to cause an issue.

Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn't their first language. For you to excel, you'll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

TA Screen / One-way Video Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview to assess spoken and written communication, relevant UK payroll experience, motivation, and initial background.

Technical Round: A 30-minute interview and practical assessment with the Hiring Team to assess UK payroll knowledge, payroll processing experience, attention to detail, ability to work with payroll data, and understanding of UK payroll processes and deadlines.

Soft Skills Round: A 30-minute chat with a member of the leadership team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values, including ownership, humility, structured thinking, communication, and ability to handle challenging situations.

Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify:

- Your education
- Any criminal history
- Any political exposure
- Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history
We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com.

Some other great things about working at Sleekâ¦

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.Â 

Flexibility: Youâll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we donât mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: Youâll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so youâll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. Thereâs also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. Weâre also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Â Since we started our journey in 2017, weâve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, weâve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

title: Technical Product Lead AI Finance App
description:
About KIRA 

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role 

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own 

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

Â 

What We're Looking For 

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Â 

Nice to have 

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Â 

Outcome 

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

You'll work alongside firm leadership to keep day-to-day HR operations running smoothly and help identify smarter, more efficient ways to manage HR processes using AI and automation.

If you enjoy variety in your work, thrive on process and organization, adapt quickly to new tools, and want to grow with a firm that invests in its people, this role is a great fit.

Key Responsibilities

Qualifications

- Excellent written and spoken English with strong, proactive communication skills â comfortable flagging issues, asking questions, and following up without being prompted (required).
- Proactive and self-directed, able to anticipate needs and take initiative in a fast-paced, fully remote environment (required).
- Minimum of 2 years of experience in HR operations for a U.S.-based company, including onboarding, compliance, or employee lifecycle support (required).
- Experience using monday.com and HRIS platforms such as Rippling (required).
- Experience creating clear documentation, SOPs, or process materials.
- Comfortable using AI tools to support content creation, documentation, and process efficiency.

- Preferred: experience with Canva or similar tools for training or communication materials.

Why Join Our Team?

- Stable, remote opportunity to work with a well-established U.S.-based law firm that values continuous learning, innovation, and professional growth.
- Competitive compensation with performance-based bonuses.
- Fully remote role within a diverse global team.
- Paid time off, including U.S. federal holidays, sick leave, and annual leave.
- Pacific Time-aligned working hours with reasonable flexibility.
- Opportunity to grow with the firm's HR function as it scales.
- Structured onboarding and clear expectations from day one.
- Stable, long-term opportunity with a growing U.S. law firm.
- Supportive and collaborative work environment built on accountability and continuous improvement.
- Thoughtful company culture, including birthday recognitions and team appreciation initiatives.

Working Hours

- Full-time role, 8 hours per day (excluding a 1-hour break).Â 
- Schedule details may be discussed during the final stages of the hiring process.Â 
- Scheduling is flexible; however, team members are required to maintain a minimum of 5â6 hours of overlap with the firm's operating hours in Pacific Time (PT), subject to operational needs and team coordination.

Application Process

Candidates may be asked to complete the following during the recruitment process:

- Most recent Resume/CV (required).
- Communication and presentation assessment, including a practical assignment relevant to HR operations, recruitment, or training material creation.
- Proof of qualifications and professional references. To ensure fairness and accuracy, compensation verification may be conducted for shortlisted candidates.

Additional Information

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, contacting our offices by phone, email, or social media regarding this position is strictly prohibited. Any inquiries about application status through these channels will result in automatic disqualification from the hiring process. Hi there, I'm Olive Turon, Head of People & Culture at TestGorilla. I'm excited to share more about the Senior People & Talent Operations Partner role and our team.

About TestGorilla

At TestGorilla, we're on a mission to place 1 billion people in their dream jobs. To democratize opportunity, we're building the world's leading skills-based talent discovery platform - one that replaces reliance on resumes with scientific validation of what people can truly do.

Founded as a 100% remote company in 2020, our global team is united by high standards, a lot of heart, and a relentless drive to conquer new technological frontiers. We're all AI-fluent builders who care deeply about replacing bias with fairness.

After empowering thousands of companies to hire smarter and faster, we're now unlocking the next phase of our scale-up journey - where you'll play an instrumental role in creating a world where skills matter most!

About the role

As our Senior People & Talent Operations Partner, you'll own People Ops as a product: the systems, compliance, and self-serve workflows that let most of People & Culture run itself day to day, plus the tooling behind how we hire. You'll join a lean, two-person team, working directly with me, with proper and lasting ownership from day one.Â 

Payroll, compliance, and HR systems across every (35, currently!) country we operate in are foundational elements of this role. Just as critically, you'll build and own the AI/automation and self-serve layer that keeps our People function lean, bringing a product mindset to everything you touch.Â Letâs face it: weâre a scale-up, so youâll also need to be happy wearing other People hats when the moment requires.

We're looking for someone autonomous, opinionated and candid, who'll tell me when I've got it wrong. You'll be dealing with real people and real problems, so you'll need to stay empathic but boundaried, structured and organized even when the pace picks up.

Iâm biased, but I think itâs a dream job: this is an HR role in an HRTech company changing the world of work for the better, weâll have immense amounts of fun, thereâs plenty of uncharted territory for you to make your own, and Iâm committed to helping you to do the best work of your life.

A quick check: if you've never built objectively clever automations (not just used one someone else built), this probably isn't the role for you. Automation is just that central to the job.

Responsibilities

In this role, your responsibilities will include:

- Upholding TestGorilla's behaviors and fostering an inclusive, supportive culture.

- Designing, building and maintaining a smart, automated and AI-enabled people journey - from pre-boarding to off-boarding - that frees up capacity for bespoke, white-glove treatment where it matters

- Being the technical owner and orchestrator of our HR tech stack: evaluating and enhancing it, ensuring these tools are not siloed but unified and integrated.

- Owning the non-Finance side of payroll, invoicing, contract administration, and compliance end to end, across every country we operate in.

- Owning data privacy and recordkeeping, and the day-to-day relationship with our EOR vendor.

- Owning configuration and troubleshooting of our hiring tooling, so hiring managers can run their own searches independently.

- Owning the documentation that makes self-serve actually work in practice, ensuring that itâs structured in a way that is easily accessible to both humans and P&C AI agents.Â 

- Working with me to maintain a clean line between what's self-serve and what needs a person. We do not aspire to automate our entire People journey here.Â 

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone who:

- Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs.

- Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

- Has built and owned sophisticated automations (Zapier, n8n, Make.com, and the like) as a core part of an integrated HR tech stack, not just used AI tools day to day. Arguably the most important thing on this list.

title: Social Comms
description:
Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr 

NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce.

Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. 

The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment.

As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â 

The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public.

You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work.

You'd be a great fit if

- You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious.
- You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have.

- You've run or grown popular social accounts before.
- You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you.
- You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about.
- You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included.
- You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time.
- You have experience in civic domains, public-good, policy, trust-and-safety, or non-profits.
Bonus: you have already published material relevant to AI and its proliferation and risks.

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. - Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

- Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

- Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.

Required Experience

- Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.

- Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

- Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills 

- Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

- Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

- Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.

- Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders.

- Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority.

title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
description:
Overview 

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale. 

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

- Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

- The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

- Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

- We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

- A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

- Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

- You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

- A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

- Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

- Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

- Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work 

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation 

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

Following consistent annual growth of 70-80% and with even more ambitious plans ahead, we are expanding our recruitment team and looking for a Cost Engineer-Estimator to help drive our continued success.

- Remote work.

Requirements

- Technical degree in Mechanical or Civil/Structural Engineering
- Strong spatial thinking and technical problem-solving skills
- Proven experience with quantity take-offs from construction and mechanical drawings
- Confident in reading and interpreting:
- Civil and mechanical drawings Hardware sets and layouts
- Proficient in Excel or Google Sheets
- Basic formulas
- High attention to detail and accuracy
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and work independently

- Available to work full-time aligned with EST timezone (8:30AM-5:00PM)

Benefits

- Clear opportunities for career development and salary increase
- Competitive salary and benefits package
- Work with a diverse and talented group of professionals
- Supportive and innovative work environment
- Paid days off and Sick leave

Please note: this is a fully remote, full-time position with a schedule from 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM (New York time).

The candidate should have strong written and verbal English communication skills (B2 level or higher) and a technical degree or proven experience as a Engineer / Estimator.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

- Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes. 
- Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements. 
- Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed. 
- Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise. 
- Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility. 
- Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port. 
- Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures. 

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

- Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
- Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
- Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work. 
- Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required. 

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

- Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy. 
- Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations. 
- Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format. 
- Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities. 
- Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work. 
- Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery. 
- Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise. 
- Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions. 
- Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others. 
- Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems. 

Physical Requirements:

- Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory. 
- The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively. 
- The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential. 
- Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment. 
- Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling. 
- The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities. 
- Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs. 
- The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required. 
- Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required. 

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

Notice

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

This job description is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an all-inclusive list of responsibilities, skills, efforts or working conditions associated with the job of the incumbent. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering , Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

- Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security. 
- Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation. 
- Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do. 
- Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
- Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it. 
- Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team. 

What You'll Bring

- Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth. 
- Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook. 
- An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code. 
- Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling. 
- Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you. 
- Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus. 
- Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus. 

What's Cool About The Role

- You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team. 
- A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders. 
- We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it. 
- Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity. 
- Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas. 
- Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook. 

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

The Clinical Coordinator Department Manager oversees the Clinical Coordination team responsible for maintaining accurate, appropriately filled provider schedules across all markets. This role provides leadership, operational oversight, training, workload management, process improvement, and cross-department collaboration to support consistent scheduling performance.

This leader sets daily and weekly priorities, delegates work, holds the team accountable, monitors current and upcoming schedule health, and identifies risks before they impact provider days. The manager ensures accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked and that scheduling barriers are tracked and escalated to the appropriate owner.

- Accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlog progress
- Schedule-entry timeliness

- Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical/dental workflows, provider scheduling, multi-facility coordination, pre-med & medical clearance processes, insurance verification, lab case coordination, and multi-facility scheduling
- Leadership: Demonstrated success managing remote teams, assigning and delegating work, coaching performance, holding employees accountable, and implementing process improvements.

- Strong organizational, delegation, and prioritization abilities
- Ability to independently assess problems, make decisions, and follow through
- Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment

- Proactive problem solving & root-cause thinking

About the role
The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do - Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
- Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
- Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
- Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
- Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
- Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
- Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
- Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.

What we are looking for - A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
- Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
- Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
- Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
- Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
- A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.

How we work
We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers - A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
- Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
- Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
- The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
- Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Senior Process Engieer
description:
ABOUT US tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of
lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming
the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a
cleaner and more innovative future.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the
design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes.
This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering,
and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into
robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our
future plants are built on solid fundamentals.
Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite
and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external
engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with:
a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development.
We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production
environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is
telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Must Have's: 
1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up
● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants.
● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process
descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions.

● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design
criteria and scale-up assumptions.
● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future
plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than
theoretical assumptions alone.
2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization
● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps.
● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of
graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing.
● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and
translate these insights into concrete process improvements.
● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on
process performance and technology development rather than daily
troubleshooting.
3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling
● Turn plant data into engineering decisions.
● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances
and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process
performance.
● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions.
● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure
that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality.
● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and
future plant designs.
4. Commissioning & Process Validation
● Make sure what we designed actually works.
● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance
validation for new equipment and plant expansions.
● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original
design intent.
● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed
systems achieve their calculated performance targets.
● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership
transfers once the process meets its design criteria.
5. Operational Readiness, Process Safety & SOPs
● Design processes that can be operated safely and consistently.
● Translate process design and engineering intent into clear Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation.
● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews,
ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather
than after installation.
● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process
parameters of newly commissioned systems.

Nice-to-have's: 
Vendor & EPC Coordination
● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners
and equipment suppliers.
● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering
documentation.
● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and
ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process.
● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process
performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability.
● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and
equipment vendors throughout project execution.

Your profile You have a strong chemical/process engineering foundation and enjoy solving
technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and
real plant data.
● Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Metallurgical
Engineering or a related technical field.
● Ideally 5+ years of experience in process engineering within the chemical,
hydrometallurgy, battery, mining, minerals, recycling or related process
industries; specific expertise in graphite and lithium extraction and
post-processing is highly preferred.
● Strong experience with process design and scale-up, including PFDs, P&IDs,
mass/energy balances and equipment sizing.
● Comfortable working with industrial datasets and translating operational data
into engineering models and decisions.
● Experience with solid-liquid separation, precipitation, flotation,
hydrometallurgy or mineral processing is highly valuable.
● Able to critically review vendor proposals and confidently challenge technical
assumptions.
● Strong experience supporting commissioning and process validation of
industrial equipment or plants.
● Familiarity with process safety methodologies such as HAZOP and LOPA.
● Comfortable moving between detailed calculations, engineering
documentation and the actual plant.
● Strong communicator who can work effectively across R&D, Engineering,
Operations, suppliers and EPC partners.
● Fluent English; German is a plus.

Why us? Our technology is moving from first-of-a-kind industrial operations toward
increasingly larger and more standardized plants.
The Senior Process Engineer will help us make that transition successfully: turning
what we learn from today's plant into the engineering basis for tomorrow's plants
while supporting commissioning and ramping up efforts.
You will directly influence process performance, equipment selection, CAPEX and the
technical architecture of our future facilities — helping ensure that every new scale is
safer, simpler, more efficient and better engineered than the one before it.

title: Account Executive – Full-Cycle, New Business (m/f/d)
description:
THE JOB Reading this to the end is worth it. 

The Company: Why mute-labs? 

mute-labs is the EU market leader in acoustic phone booths, with more than 20,000 cabins sold and counting. We are self-funded, profitable since day one, and have no investors to answer to and no exit to chase. What we do have is a steep growth curve in revenue, a product made in Germany, and a genuine mission: giving the modern office some quiet back. 

We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. What we have not built yet is a real outbound engine for winning bigger accounts on purpose, from ambitious growth companies to household names like Volkswagen, adidas, IKEA, Red Bull, or Axel Springer, who already trust us today. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you. 

Outbound is not a new idea for us. We have piloted it in smaller pockets already, testing signal-based outreach and structured sequences with real results. What has been missing is someone to own this as a dedicated motion for bigger accounts rather than a side project squeezed in between other things. That is why we are building this out as a new department and you’d be joining a small, yet focussed team as one of the first hires. 

The Role: Build the Pipeline AND the Channel 

This is a founding position. You are not stepping into an existing sales org with a quota handed down from three reps before you. You are the first one in the building. What you build, and how you build it, is largely up to you and your team, and you can grow the size and ambition of your target accounts as you find your footing. 

- Green Field, Full Ownership: Build your own pipeline from scratch. There is no inherited book of business and no recycled leads. The customer base you build is yours, and so is the revenue you generate from it. 

- Your Stack, Your Sequences: Clay, Reply.io, LinkedIn Premium, and Aircall are all at your disposal. You design your own outreach sequences, run your own cold calling campaigns, and decide how the machine works. Nobody hands you a script. 

- Segment Strategy, Together: You understand the market as well as anyone. Rather than being handed a target list from above, you and your manager will decide together which segments and account types are worth focusing on. 

- Comp That Rewards More Than the First Deal: An uncapped bonus with a kicker for overperformance. Returning customers you bring in keep feeding your comp over time, not just the initial close. Landing an account well is worth more than landing it once. 

- A Brand That Opens Doors: You are not cold-calling on behalf of an unknown startup. mute-labs is an established, well-regarded market leader with a reference list that already includes some of the biggest names in German and European business. That credibility is yours to use from day one. 

- A seasoned team to back you up: Your manager has built and run outbound and enterprise sales hands-on, from cold pipeline to six-figure closes, and will work closely with you from day one, coaching, supporting, and training wherever it's actually needed rather than just checking in on numbers. 

Is This You? 

- The Go-Getter: You do not wait to be told what to do next. You get on your feet quickly, figure out the shape of the problem, and start moving before anyone has to push you. 

- Sales Experience: You have carried a full sales cycle before, from first contact to signed contract, and know how to keep a deal moving without needing someone else to close it for you. You do not need to have sold into large enterprises already, that is something you will grow into here. 

- Stakeholder Management: You know how to work a deal with more than one person in the room, decision-makers, influencers, and budget holders, and you can keep several of those relationships moving in parallel without losing the thread. 

- Comfortable with Ambiguity: There is no existing playbook to inherit here. You will help write it. If you need every process defined for you before you can start, this is not the role. 

- Fluent in German and English: Most of your target accounts are DACH-based, though the reference list extends across the EU. Strong German is expected; English is the internal working language. 

Our Hiring Process 

We keep this fast and honest, on both sides. 

- The Spark: A short intro call with our People team to check for basic fit. 

- The deepdive: A conversation with your future manager Patrick about your experience, how you build your pipeline and how you close. Here you’ll also meet the rest of the team. 

- The Live Action: A live discovery or negotiation role-play based on a realistic enterprise scenario. No prep deck, just show us how you actually work a deal. 

- The Vision: A final conversation with Leah, Head of Sales as well as Franziskus, Managing Director, on the strategic mandate behind this role and where it can go from here. 

ABOUT US mute-labs exists to make quiet a normal part of the modern workplace. A few things that set us apart: 

- We are "no tech" : we build and sell real hardware, sound-insulated phone and meeting booths that companies actually need. 

- We have no investors , and we are not looking for any. We have been profitable since day one. 

- We are on a steep growth curve , measured in revenue and profit, not headcount for its own sake. 

- We are not building toward an exit . We are building a company meant to last for generations. 

Skip the Queue Told you it was worth reading to the end. 

We are looking for someone with a go-getter attitude who does not wait around for permission. So here is your first test: don't apply through the form. Cold call your future manager, Patrick, directly. 

+49 15888 279908 

If you get through and make your case, you've already shown us more than any CV could.

title: (Senior) Marketing Manager B2B Tech (m/w) | 30-40 h in Altenstadt bei Frankfurt am Main
description:
Starke Themen. Starke Basis. Jetzt kommst du.

Gestaltungsfreiheit statt Marketing nach Vorlage

Wenn Netzwerke ausfallen, Sicherheitslücken entstehen oder IT-Infrastrukturen nicht mit dem Unternehmen mitwachsen, wird es schnell kritisch. Genau dort setzen die Unternehmen der nscon group an: Wir sorgen dafür, dass komplexe IT sicherer, zuverlässiger und zukunftsfähiger wird.

Unsere Experten bringen dafür jede Menge technisches Wissen und Erfahrung mit. Jetzt suchen wir eine erfahrene Marketing-Persönlichkeit, die das Potenzial darin erkennt und daraus starke Marken, relevante Geschichten, durchdachte Kampagnen und echte Nachfrage entwickelt.

Jemanden, der Marketing nicht einfach am Laufen hält, sondern sichtbar weiterentwickelt.

Wer wir sind

Die nscon group vereint drei IT-Unternehmen:

- nscon berät Unternehmen rund um Network, Security und Automation und entwickelt individuelle Lösungen für komplexe IT-Umgebungen.

- nsconverge übernimmt den zuverlässigen Betrieb von IT-Infrastrukturen und entwickelt skalierbare Managed Services.

- CST bringt langjährige Erfahrung in den Bereichen IT-Infrastruktur, Connectivity und Security ein.

Gemeinsam begleiten wir Unternehmen von der Beratung über die technische Umsetzung bis zum sicheren Betrieb.

Unsere Arbeit findet häufig im Hintergrund statt. Ihre Wirkung ist trotzdem unmittelbar spürbar: Systeme bleiben verfügbar, Daten geschützt und Unternehmen handlungsfähig.

Genau diese Wirkung soll durch dein Marketing noch sichtbarer werden.

Aufgaben

Was du bei uns bewegst

Du gibst unserem Marketing eine klare Richtung 

- Du entwickelst die Marketingstrategie der nscon group gemeinsam mit Geschäftsführung und Vertrieb weiter.

- Du schärfst Zielgruppen, Positionierungen, Botschaften und Prioritäten für unsere unterschiedlichen Marken und Leistungen.

- Du setzt klare Prioritäten, wählst die passenden Kanäle & Maßnahmen und verzahnst Marketing und Vertrieb zu einem gemeinsamen Prozess.

Du machst aus Fachwissen relevanten Content 

- Du erkennst die Geschichten hinter unseren Projekten, Lösungen und Experten.

- Du entwickelst daraus Content für Websites, LinkedIn, Instagram, Newsletter, Podcast, Video und weitere passende Formate für IT-Entscheider inkl. SEO & GEO

- Du führst Interviews mit unseren technischen Kollegen und übersetzt komplexe Themen in Inhalte, die Entscheider verstehen und relevant finden

- Du entwickelst unsere Experten gezielt zu sichtbaren Thought Leadern.

- Du planst nicht nur, sondern kannst Ideen auch selbst schnell und pragmatisch umsetzen.

Du entwickelst Kampagnen, die etwas auslösen 

- Du entwickelst Kampagnen von der ersten Idee über Ads, Content und Landingpages bis zur Leadgenerierung und Übergabe an den Vertrieb.

- Dafür findest du relevante Herausforderungen unserer Zielgruppen und entwickelst daraus Botschaften, Angebote und kreative Aufhänger.

- Du definierst KPIs, steuerst organische und bezahlte Maßnahmen wie LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads und SEA, wertest ihre Wirkung aus und entwickelst erfolgreiche Ansätze weiter.

- Du entwickelst unsere Marken, Websites und Marketingmaterialien weiter und sorgst für einen konsistenten visuellen und sprachlichen Auftritt.

- Du nutzt KI und Marketing-Automatisierung, steuerst Agenturen, Budgets und Timings und führst unsere Werkstudentin fachlich.

- Du probierst neue Formate und Kanäle aus und bewertest, was zu unseren Zielgruppen und unseren Zielen passt und hast gleichzeitig den Mut, Maßnahmen zu beenden, die nicht funktionieren.

- Du gestaltest auch Events, Werbemittel und Merchandise als Teil eines stimmigen Markenerlebnisses.

- Du musst nicht jedes Video selbst schneiden und nicht jedes Design allein erstellen. Aber du kannst Qualität beurteilen, klar briefen und bei Bedarf auch selbst ins operative Doing gehen.

Qualifikation

Du könntest genau richtig sein, wenn …

- Du mehrere Jahre Erfahrung (mind. 3-5) im B2B-Marketing erklärungsbedürftiger Produkte oder Dienstleistungen – idealerweise in IT, Technologie, Beratung, SaaS oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld gesammelt und bereits eigene Projekte, Kampagnen oder Marketingbereiche verantwortet hast

- Du starke Ideen entwickelst, aber nicht bei der Idee stehen bleibst

- Du Marketing und Vertrieb nicht als getrennte Welten betrachtest

- Du komplexe Themen schnell verstehst und daraus klare Botschaften entwickelst

- Du ein gutes Gespür für Zielgruppen, Plattformen, Trends und Markenwirkung mitbringst

- Du selbst erkennst, was als Nächstes getan werden muss, und Verantwortung dafür übernimmst

- Du neue Dinge gerne ausprobierst, ihre Wirkung aber auch kritisch hinterfragst

- Du zwischen Strategie, Kreation, Projektmanagement und Umsetzung wechseln kannst

- Du sicher mit Social Media, Content-Management-Systemen und digitalen Marketing-Tools umgehst (wie Canva, Figma, Adobe, etc.)

- Du sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch mitbringst.

Dein Abschluss ist für uns zweitrangig. Entscheidend ist, was du bereits aufgebaut, verbessert, erfolgreich vermarktet oder messbar bewegt hast.

Benefits

Was dich bei uns erwartet

- Eine neu ausgerichtete Rolle mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum

- Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb und technischen Entscheidern

- Kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, Ideen schnell auszuprobieren

- Drei Marken, die du sichtbar weiterentwickeln kannst

- Anspruchsvolle B2B-Themen mit konkreter Wirkung auf die Arbeitsfähigkeit und Sicherheit von Unternehmen

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne Kernarbeitszeit, teilweise im Home Office

- 30 Tage Urlaub

- 40 Stunden Weiterbildungszeit pro Jahr sowie Übernahme der Weiterbildungskosten

- Vollständige Übernahme der Kosten für Kita oder Tagesmutter

- Überstundenausgleich im Verhältnis 1:1

- Weitere Benefits wie betriebliche Krankenversicherung, Altersvorsorge, VWL und monatlicher Rewe Einkaufsgutschein

💬 Zeig uns, was du bewegen kannst

Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf oder dein LinkedIn-Profil und erzähl uns kurz von einem Marketingprojekt, auf das du stolz bist:

- Was war die Ausgangslage?

- Was war dein konkreter Anteil?

- Was hast du damit erreicht?

Ein Link oder einige kurze Sätze reichen vollkommen aus.

title: Cyber Security Engineer — Infrastructure & AI Platform Security (w/m/d)
description:
Über IONOS

Bei IONOS verwalten wir nicht nur Server, wir prägen mit unseren Lösungen die digitale Zukunft für über 6,2 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit. Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools.

Was uns antreibt: Digitale Entscheidungsfreiheit für Europa und echter Impact für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) sowie Großunternehmen. Wir arbeiten in agilen Teams, setzen auf transparente Strukturen und glauben daran, dass Exzellenz und Innovation nur mit echtem Teamgeist entstehen.

Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns.

Beide Hälften dieser Rolle drehen sich um dieselbe grundlegende Frage: Welche Systeme können unsere empfindlichste Infrastruktur erreichen und unter welchen Kontrollen. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Sicherheitsarchitektur unserer providerseitigen Infrastrukturschicht und bist Fachexperte (m/w/d) für die intern betriebenen KI-Plattformen und -Agenten. Dabei stellst Du sicher, dass diese in einem sicheren, verwalteten und auditierbaren Zustand laufen, anstatt sich schleichend als neue Klasse von privilegierten Zugriffen anzuhäufen.

Dies ist eine praxisnahe Expertenrolle. Du setzt Standards, prüfst Designs auf Herz und Nieren und arbeitest direkt mit Plattform- und Engineering-Teams über all unsere Marken hinweg zusammen, um diese umzusetzen.

Aufgabenbereich

Infrastruktursicherheit

- Definieren und Pflegen von Sicherheitsarchitektur-Standards und Härtungs-Baselines für providerseitige Infrastruktur: Virtualisierungs- und Container-Plattformen, Control Planes und Bereitstellungssysteme, DNS, Mail-Infrastruktur sowie Backup- und Wiederherstellungssysteme.

- Bewerten und Stärken der Mandantenisolierung über Shared-Hosting-, Virtualisierungs- und Container-Schichten hinweg sowie Treiben von Behebungsmaßnahmen mit den verantwortlichen Plattform-Teams.

- Überprüfen von Infrastruktur-Designs und wesentlichen Änderungen auf Sicherheitsauswirkungen sowie Agieren als Eskalationsinstanz für Fragen zur Infrastruktursicherheit aus Plattform-, Cloud- und Marken-Engineering-Teams.

- Reduzieren des Blast Radius auf den wichtigsten Pfaden: privilegierter Zugriff auf kundenorientierte Infrastruktur, administrative Segmentierung, Umgang mit Secrets und Wiederherstellungsintegrität — übersetzt in umsetzbare markenspezifische Implementierungspläne für unsere heterogenen Plattformen.

- Unterstützen von Cyber Defense, Vulnerability Management und IT-Notfallmanagement mit Infrastruktur-Expertise bei Vorfällen und der Nachbereitung/Härtung.

Interne KI-Plattform- und Agentensicherheit

- Verantwortung für die Sicherheitsarchitektur und Baseline-Standards für die intern betriebenen KI-Plattformen: Modell-Gateways und self-hosted Modelle, Agenten-Frameworks, Assistenten-Integrationen, Konnektoren und Retrieval-Pipelines über interne Daten.

- Definieren und Durchsetzen, wie Agenten identifiziert, authentifiziert und autorisiert werden: Umgang mit nicht-menschlichen Identitäten, Credential- und Token-Management, Least-Privilege-Zugriff auf Tools und Systeme sowie Festlegung, wo autonomes Handeln ein Human-in-the-Loop erfordert.

- Festlegen, welche Daten interne KI-Systeme aufrufen und indexieren dürfen, sowie Sicherstellen, dass Agentenaktivitäten protokolliert, zuordenbar und überprüfbar sind — entsprechend den Anforderungen unserer regulatorischen Verpflichtungen und Zertifizierungen.

- Durchführen von Pre-Deployment-Sicherheitsprüfungen für neue interne KI-Plattformen und Agenten-Anwendungsfälle im Einklang mit dem schnellen Tempo der Adaption sowie Überblicken von ungesicherter/unsanktionierter KI-Nutzung (Shadow AI).

- Beraten der Sicherheitsfunktionen und internen Engineering-Teams bei der sicheren Einführung von KI, einschließlich der Schutzplanken (Guardrails), die eine vertretbare Einführung ermöglichen.

Qualifikationen

- Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Infrastruktur- oder Plattform-Sicherheit, idealerweise bei einem Hosting-Anbieter, Cloud-Anbieter, Telekommunikationsunternehmen oder in einer vergleichbar großen Mandantenumgebung.

- Tiefes praktisches Wissen über Linux, Virtualisierungs- und Container-Plattformen, Netzwerke und die Sicherheitseigenschaften von Mandanten-Infrastrukturen.

- Starker Hintergrund im Bereich Identity & Access: Privileged Access, Maschinen- und Workload-Identitäten, Secrets Management, Autorisierungsmodelle und Infrastructure-as-Code-Sicherheit.

- Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Durchsetzung von Sicherheitsstandards in einer heterogenen, teils historisch gewachsenen Landschaft sowie bei der Akzeptanzgewinnung in Teams außerhalb der eigenen Führungslinie.

- Praktische Kenntnisse im Aufbau und Betrieb von LLM- und Agenten-Systemen sowie der spezifischen Risiken: Prompt Injection durch unvertraute Daten, zu weit gefasste Tool-Zugriffe, Datenexposition durch Retrieval, unprotokolliertes autonomes Handeln, Modell- und Anbieterabhängigkeiten.

- Fähigkeit, risikobasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und zu verteidigen — einschließlich des Blockierens von Deployments mit klarer Begründung — sowie technisches Risiko gegenüber nicht-technischen Stakeholdern verständlich zu erklären.

- Fließende Englischkenntnisse; Deutschkenntnisse sind aufgrund unseres regulatorischen Umfelds und des öffentlichen Sektors von starkem Vorteil.

Wünschenswert / Von Vorteil

- Praktische Erfahrung beim Deployment oder der Absicherung interner KI-Plattformen, Agenten-Frameworks oder Tool-Calling-Integrationen in einer Produktionsumgebung.

- Vertrautheit mit NIS2 / BSIG oder ISO 27001.

- Hintergrund in DNS, E-Mail-Infrastruktur oder plattformnaher Missbrauchsbekämpfung (Abuse).

- Erfahrung in einem Multimarken- oder Post-Acquisition-Umfeld, in dem dieselbe Control in verschiedenen Implementierungen umgesetzt werden muss.

- Hintergrund in Security Engineering oder Softwareentwicklung (Automatisierung, Tooling, Scripting).

Wer zu uns passt 

Jemand, der sich wohl damit fühlt, bei bestimmten Fragestellungen die/der einzige Expert*in im Raum zu sein, der lieber Ursachen behebt als nur Befunde zu dokumentieren, und der über Sicherheitsfunktionen und Plattform-Teams hinweg agieren kann. Du solltest echtes Interesse an KI-Systemen als Engineering-Artefakte mitbringen, nicht nur als Richtlinienthema — ein Großteil dieser Praxis entsteht gerade erst, und Du wirst unsere mitgestalten.

Benefits

- Hybrides Arbeitsmodell.

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke.

- Moderne Büroflächen mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung.

- Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte.

- Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommer- und Winterfeiern, sowie Workshops.

- Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

- Verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote, wie Sport- und Gesundheitskurse.

Hinweis zur Bewerbung

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von z. B. Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität, körperlichen Merkmalen, Familienstand oder einem anderen sachfremden Kriterium nach geltendem Recht.

title: Mediengestalter/-in Digital (m/w/d) - Teilzeit oder Vollzeit
description:
Für unsere Kunden suchen wir jemanden, der Print, Web und Social Media gestaltet und mit den Leuten spricht, für die es gemacht ist.

Wer ist FAKT.? 

Sieben Leute in Aurich, mitten in Ostfriesland. Wir entwickeln Marken, Botschaften und Auftritte für unsere Kunden. Vom Handwerksbetrieb zwei Straßen weiter bis zum Industrieunternehmen mit Standorten in halb Europa.

Full Service heißt bei uns, dass wirklich alles hier im Haus passiert: Marke und Corporate Design, WordPress-Websites, Social Media, Foto und Video, Text und Redaktion. Was wir konzipieren, setzen wir auch selbst um.

Wir sind klein genug, dass jeder weiß, woran die anderen sechs gerade arbeiten. Und groß genug für Projekte, die man auch zwei Jahre später noch gern herzeigt.

Aufgaben

Was du bei uns machst 

Du setzt und gestaltest. Geschäftsausstattung, Flyer, Broschüren, Anzeigen, Plakate. Druckfertig und sauber, und wenn die Druckerei anruft, weißt du, worum es geht.

Du arbeitest an Websites mit. Seiten bauen, Inhalte einpflegen, Bilder vorbereiten, kleine Anpassungen im Layout. Unsere Seiten laufen auf WordPress, den Rest zeigen wir dir.

Du machst Content für Social Media. Karussells, Story-Vorlagen, Grafiken für Kampagnen. Oft aus Fotos, die wir selbst beim Kunden gemacht haben, nicht aus der Stockdatenbank.

Und du betreust Kunden. Abstimmungen, Korrekturschleifen, Rückfragen. Bei uns sitzt keine Kontaktabteilung zwischen dir und den Leuten, für die du gestaltest.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst 

Du hast schon in einer Agentur gearbeitet und kennst den Rhythmus: mehrere Kunden gleichzeitig, Prioritäten, die sich am Dienstag noch mal ändern.

InDesign, Illustrator und Photoshop sind für dich Werkzeug, kein Hindernis. Wenn ein Tool neu ist, lernst du es.

Du hast ein Auge für Typografie und Raster. Und du merkst, wenn etwas nicht stimmt, bevor der Kunde es merkt.
