title: Clinical Support Expert (Germany)
description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

Location: Berlin (can be remote) · Supports German markets

Dandy is hiring a Clinical Support Expert to join our rapidly growing, venture-backed company. As a critical member of the Customer Experience Team, you will ensure our dental professionals across Germany receive best-in-class technical expertise and customer service. You will serve as a high-level clinical authority, tackling the most complex cases and driving quality improvements across the organization.

What You'll Do 

As a Clinical Support Expert, you will leverage your deep technical knowledge to support doctors, coach team members, and ensure operational excellence.

Expert Case Resolution & Support 

- Resolve complex clinical inquiries , handling time-sensitive escalations from frontline agents, Account Management, and cross-functional teams with expert precision and clinical accuracy.

- Manage booked calls to advise and work to resolve complex, practice-level case issues.

- Serve as the primary escalation point for inbound clinical support tickets, providing customer service and clinical guidance to doctors via phone, live chat, video and email regarding complex cases, and treatment planning.

- Serve as the clinical voice for our German doctor base , supporting practices, while flexing to support other EU customers during periods of overlapping volume.

- Act as the liaison between doctors and the lab , translating clinical feedback and preferences into actionable outcomes for live orders.

Quality Assurance and Training Leadership 

- Perform Quality Assurance (QA) reviews of agent work to ensure clinical accuracy and adherence to Dandy standard operating procedures.

- Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support and coach new hires, providing specialized clinical training and offering ongoing guidance to the frontline team.

- Advise on and lead special cross-functional projects aimed at improving clinical processes and outcomes.

- Assist in the creation, review, and updates of Knowledge Base articles , including the localization of German-language articles and doctor-facing communications, to maintain an accurate and comprehensive repository of clinical information across both service languages.

- Propose and oversee the up-leveling of clinical knowledge and quality standards based on trends and doctor feedback.

Performance Measured By 

- QA and Clinical Accuracy: The precision and correctness of your clinical guidance and resolutions including mastery of Dandy digital dental workflows and best practices in both service languages.

- SLAs for Escalation Handling: Timeliness and effectiveness in resolving escalated issues.

- Effectiveness of Training and Coaching: The positive impact of your SME support on new hire ramp-up and overall team performance.

- Schedule Adherence and Attendance: Consistency in maintaining your assigned schedule and compliance to attendance policy.

What We're Looking For 

- Fluent in German and English , written and verbal, with the ability to deliver clinical guidance and build rapport with doctors in either language.

- Based in Germany and legally authorized to work in Germany.

- Minimum 5+ years of experience in a high-volume lab setting, with experience in digital dental labs being a plus.

- Minimum 3+ years of experience in 3Shape CAD/CAM digital design in [Product Line].

- Strong current knowledge of [Product Line] dental systems and their digital components (i.e., scan bodies).

- Familiarity with the German dental market — state and federal regulatory context, German clinical terminology, and product naming conventions — is a strong plus.

- Prior experience in a customer-facing role within a lab or dental organization.

- Customer-focused mindset: driven to connect with doctors, troubleshoot issues, and deliver an exceptional experience.

- Skilled at building rapport with clinicians, providing empathetic support, and handling complex concerns with professionalism.

- Confident engaging with doctors in real time via chat, phone, or video calls, answering questions and building trust quickly.

- Proficient in computer applications, with excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to convert clinical and technical feedback into clear, actionable insights.

- Experienced in training & coaching , acting as a subject matter expert, and mentoring colleagues to elevate performance.

- Skilled at reviewing and assessing the quality of work to ensure accuracy and adherence to standards.

- Highly independent problem solver with a strong sense of accountability.

- Proven track record of meeting service level agreements (SLAs) while maintaining high-quality standards for every case.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to review multiple case outcomes and provide informed clinical guidance.

- Comfortable working hours that provide coverage across our operating hours.

- Enthusiastic about working in a fast-growing, fully digital lab and contributing to a high-performance culture.

- Additional European languages — Italian, Spanish, Dutch, or French — are a plus.

description:
Company Description Since its creation in 2007 in the financial city of Frankfurt am Main, Solactive AG has grown to one of the key players in the indexing space. The German multi-asset index provider focusses on tailor-made indices, offering to its clients a faster service, with greater flexibility and at a reasonable cost. Solactive AG and its subsidiaries have become one of the fastest growing index providers over the past few years and support the leading investment banks and asset managers across the globe. We have gained global recognition for our role in the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) industry, where we rank among the top providers worldwide for underlying indices. We also excel in diverse areas such as Structured Products and investment mandates, showcasing the wide range of our capabilities. The impact and value we bring to the market is palpable, but also in the reputation we have proudly built by being close to our customers, solidifying Solactive AG as a trusted and reliable ally in the ever-evolving global financial landscape.

Job Overview Solactive's Aggregate team owns the intraday calculation of our indices: consuming live price streams, applying calculation logic across a wide range of indices, and producing a continuous output stream of index ticks throughout the trading day. The core platform is built in Java and engineered around throughput, latency, and correctness under concurrency, while custom business integrations are built in Python. As a Working Student you join a small team and contribute real, production-bound code to both, working alongside senior engineers who review your work and coach you.

Your Tasks - Implement well-scoped features and fixes in the Java calculation platform, such as improvements to calculation components, price stream consumption, or index tick production
- Write unit, integration, and performance tests, including tests for concurrent code paths where ordering and timing matter
- Help investigate correctness or performance issues: reproduce them, narrow them down, and propose fixes with senior guidance
- Build and maintain Python integrations for business teams: connectors to the calculation platform, output adapters, validation checks, and small operational tools
- Contribute to monitoring and developer tooling that makes calculation behaviour observable and easier to reason about
- Take part in design and code reviews, ask questions, and document what you learn so the next person can pick it up faster

Your Profile - Enrolled student in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related field
- Strong Java fundamentals: object-oriented design, collections, generics, and comfort reading and writing idiomatic modern Java
- Solid grounding in core computer science: data structures, algorithms, and complexity, and in particular a working understanding of multithreading and concurrency (threads, synchronisation, memory visibility, races and deadlocks)
- Openness to Python: no prior experience needed, but willingness to pick it up for integration and tooling work alongside Java
- Familiarity with Git, the command line, and a testing mindset; interest in measuring performance rather than guessing at it
- Ability to work independently on a scoped task, ask for help early when stuck, and communicate clearly in writing
- Available for 15–20 hours per week during the semester, more during semester breaks
- Interest in financial markets, market data, or index calculation is welcome but not required

Our Offer - Be part of the Solactive family an international FinTech environment with flat hierarchies, real ownership, and strong growth opportunities.
- Enjoy attractive benefits such as team events, Corporate Benefits access, a modern ergonomic office,free beverages and fruit.
- Work on a real, high-impact production platform and contribute to architectural improvements not just feature tickets.
- Gain hands-on experience with Java microservices, build systems, and dependency governance while collaborating with experienced engineers.
- Build practical backend engineering skills that directly support your long-term career development.

What we do AI is redefining how companies compete. Most organizations know they need to transform but only few know how to realize it. As AI Transformation Manager at Merantix Momentum, you are the person who bridges that gap: turning strategic ambition into lasting organizational change. Merantix Momentum is developing the next generation of impact-driven AI. As a Berlin-based startup, we are driving enterprise AI transformations across industries by building and deploying B2B solutions, orchestrating scaled, AI-native operations. We work across several domains including automotive, manufacturing, healthcare, and others, transforming businesses through ML using our core expertise in state-of-the-art machine learning. Your role As an AI Transformation Manager at Merantix Momentum, you bring deep domain and consulting experience to lead clients through end-to-end AI transformation, from identifying strategic opportunities to driving organizational and technical change at scale. You are equally comfortable leading a focused 6-week engagement with a 500-person Mittelstand manufacturer as well as a multi-phase transformation with a large enterprise. You act as a trusted sparring partner to executives, steer complex transformation programs across functions, and bridge the gap between technical possibilities and business imperatives. 

You support our business growth by contributing to lead conversion, proposal writing, and pre-sales activities with entrepreneurial energy. With a strong presence and an opinionated point of view, you represent Merantix Momentum’s AI Transformation perspective externally through expert discussions, LinkedIn content, and thought leadership in our core verticals. 

Internally, you contribute to the continuous development of our AI Transformation offering by evolving expertise, methods, and tools, leading by example with a fast-paced, can-do attitude and high degree of self-assurance. You are fluent in modern AI trends and applied technology and you can educate, challenge, and influence stakeholders with credibility and confidence. 

You don't just advise on AI: you understand how it truly works. You are fluent in modern AI capabilities and can explain how AI capabilities, products, and bespoke Machine Learning solutions are built. This allows you to credibly champion solutions, evaluate investment choices, navigate technical trade-offs, and convince key stakeholders of AI's transformative value. 

Your main responsibilities will include the following: 

- Lead AI Transformation Programs: Steer the end-to-end execution of AI transformation engagements — from first lighthouse use case to company-wide rollout. Find the internal champions, manage the blockers, build multi-threaded stakeholder relationships, and drive measurable adoption and organizational change. 

- Support Key Account Growth: Convert pipeline opportunities into growing account relationships and multi-layered transformation programs with the Sales team; support pre-sales, proposal writing, and key-account expansion with an entrepreneurial mindset. 

- Thought Leadership & Advocacy: Represent Merantix Momentum's opinion on AI transformation by inspiring and challenging stakeholders with opinionated, hands-on perspectives on applied AI trends, real-world adoption pathways, and what it actually takes to move from pilot to scale. 

- Advance the AI Transformation practice: Evolve our methodologies, tools, and frameworks to keep our offering state-of-the-art and to develop reusable transformation playbooks, bringing in consulting or domain expertise into the team. 

- Enable Colleagues: Advise colleagues on AI transformation best practices by leading project teams, sharing lessons learned, and contributing to a fast-paced, can-do culture. 

When applying please include a cover letter explaining your fit and motivation for this role as AI Transformation Manager. 

Your profile At our heart, we remain a startup and define ourselves by a culture of ownership and cooperation. We are looking for driven, capable, and prudent talents with a strong motivation and hunger for new challenges and opportunities to learn and grow. 

- You are a team player and willing to learn, support and grow in a team and as a company. 

- Preferably 8+ years of full-time working experience in management consulting, enterprise technology, AI/ML-driven companies, or other fast-paced environments like leading startups and boutique consulting firms. 

- Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation programs with the ability to manage executive stakeholders and drive organizational change. 

- Strong fluency in advising on AI, orchestrating its build, operating a model allowing organizations to scale AI, and enabling management to make the right investments. 

- Knowledgeable about common machine learning techniques and trends; experience in AI use case conceptualization and assessing technical feasibility. 

- Demonstrated experience in change management and embedding AI capabilities within client organizations. 

- Curiosity to constantly explore and learn about new AI solutions at the intersection of technology and business. 

- Great communication skills in German and English. 

What we offer You will become part of a highly capable and motivated team driven by a joint mission and eager to learn and grow with and from each other. We are an international and diverse team always supporting and challenging each other to get out the best in each of us. Become part of the entire Merantix ecosystem at the AI Campus in Berlin and join us on transforming the European AI landscape. - Engaging Topics and Excellence: Merantix offers unique insights into applied machine learning research and development, working with a group of highly talented engineers, researchers and entrepreneurs

title: Team Lead AI Engineering (f/m/d)
description:
We're digitizing the construction industry – are you in? At VESTIGAS, you build the digital backbone of the construction supply chain. We turn purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices into a digital, legally compliant platform used in everyday operations by construction companies and suppliers. You’ll work on a product with real market traction in the DACH mid-market, ship iteratively, and take ownership of solutions that must work in the field—not just in theory.

Your Role As Team Lead – AI Engineering, you'll own the AI infrastructure and capabilities that power our supply chain platform end to end – from pipeline design to production deployment. You bring prior leadership experience and are ready to lead a team of AI engineers: setting technical direction, growing your team's capabilities, and making sure the team consistently delivers reliable, scalable AI systems.

The Technical Challenge Your team will tackle problems like extracting structured data reliably from many different documents, building uncertainty estimation so the system knows when to flag a document for human review instead of silently guessing, and automatically reconciling purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices against each other – all within legal and compliance requirements that leave no room for "close enough." This is a domain where clean benchmark metrics mean far less than robustness against real documents nobody has seen before – and you'll set the technical direction for how the team navigates that trade-off, deciding where to push automation further and where human review still matters.

Your Mission - Lead and long-term grow a team of AI engineers, providing both strategical technical direction and people leadership
- Own MLOps processes and infrastructure, ensuring our AI systems are reliable, scalable, and secure
- Drive the design and implementation of advanced AI features, partnering closely with engineering and product leadership to deploy machine learning models and data pipelines
- Set the bar for accuracy, efficiency, and uncertainty estimation of our AI features through rigorous testing practices
- Ensure the scalability, maintainability, and core functionality of our AI solutions – and drive the build of new ones from scratch
- Translate customer needs into technical priorities and represent AI engineering in strategic product and sales discussions
- Establish and evolve engineering standards, tooling, and quality practices across the team
- Coach and develop your team members, supporting their technical and professional growth
- Champion the use of modern AI tools such as Claude or Cursor across the team

Your Profile - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; alternatively, an equivalent education
- 5+ years of experience in AI engineering and at least 1+ years in a leading position, including end-to-end lifecycle management and MLOps
- Proven experience leading or managing a technical team, with strong people-leadership skills
- Hands-on expertise in natural language processing and image processing
- Strong Python skills and experience with Azure; Terraform experience is a plus
- A passion for generative AI, OCR, and building customer-focused solutions
- A habit of writing clean, well-tested code with an eye on what happens after deployment
- Solid understanding of AI agents, tools, and their limitations
- Fluent English and German (C1 or above)
- Willingness to work from our Munich office at least two days a week

Your Benefits - Real ownership instead of micromanagement. You shape, you decide, and you see the impact of your work directly in the market.
- Direct line to founders and leadership. Flat hierarchies are our everyday reality – short paths, fast decisions.
- AI-First workflow. Copilot, Claude, Cursor & co. are standard tools for us. We expect and support their use.
- Hybrid work with an office in the heart of Munich, just around the corner from Theresienwiese. Flexible setup with regular office presence – because we believe the best ideas happen in person.
- EGYM Wellpass or BahnCard, corporate benefits, team events, annual offsites.
- Fair, competitive compensation.

title: AI Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Karriere Wir suchen erfahrene AI Engineers, die KI nicht nur demonstrieren, sondern produktiv bekommen – als Teil komplexer Business-Anwendungen, die im Alltag unserer Kunden tragen müssen. Du bist Softwareentwickler mit echter Engineering-Tiefe, idealerweise mit Full-Stack-Erfahrung, und du bewegst dich sicher in Cloud-Umgebungen wie AWS und/oder Azure. Du denkst LLMs, Agenten und datengetriebene Services von Anfang an mit – und weißt, wo sie fachlich sinnvoll sind und wo nicht.

Ein Schwerpunkt liegt für uns im Agentic Engineering: Systeme, die nicht nur antworten, sondern handeln – mit Tool-Zugriff, mehrstufigen Abläufen, Zustand, Fehlerbehandlung und klar definierten Grenzen. Genau hier trennt sich der Prototyp von der Lösung, die man einem Kunden guten Gewissens übergibt. Und genau hier brauchen wir Leute, die beides können: Modelle verstehen und robuste Software bauen.

Wichtig ist uns: Diese Rolle bleibt hands-on. Du baust selbst, du deployst selbst, du debuggst selbst. 

Bei nerdware steht nicht nur der Code im Mittelpunkt, sondern vor allem der Mensch dahinter. Die beste technische Lösung entsteht dort, wo Teamgeist, offene Kommunikation und gegenseitiges Vertrauen gelebt werden. Wenn du menschlich zu uns passt, hast du den wichtigsten Schritt bereits gemacht.

Wir arbeiten in einem Feld, das sich schneller verändert als jedes andere in der Softwareentwicklung. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, neugierig bleiben und Hype von Substanz unterscheiden können. Eigeninitiative, technischer Weitblick und die Freude daran, gemeinsam Lösungen zu entwickeln, sind uns genauso wichtig wie ein respektvoller und wertschätzender Umgang im Team.

Deine Aufgaben - Konzeption, Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von KI-gestützten Softwarelösungen – von der ersten Idee bis in den stabilen Produktivbetrieb
- Agentic Engineering: Entwurf und Umsetzung agentischer Systeme – Tool- und Function-Calling, Orchestrierung mehrstufiger Workflows, Kontext- und State-Management, Retries und Fallbacks, Human-in-the-Loop und sinnvolle Guardrails
- Design und Umsetzung von LLM-Anwendungen: RAG-Pipelines, strukturierte Extraktion, Evaluation, Observability
- Integration von ML-Modellen, Foundation Models und datengetriebenen Services in bestehende oder neue Systeme – inklusive der APIs, Datenflüsse und Infrastruktur drumherum

title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/x)
description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth, not comfort.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.

We build high-performing consumer products in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming, leading one of its largest innovations, a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences.

Senior Product Manager (f/m/x) isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger business picture, considering cross-functional impact across Engineering, Data, Marketing, and Operations, and turning strategy into product decisions that create real value, knowing every change you ship affects millions of users. At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.

If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Own:

- Own one of exmox's highest-impact product domains end-to-end, shaping the reward economy through payout thresholds, tiering, bonuses, promotions, and other key levers that drive profitability.

- Drive activation, retention, and long-term engagement through onboarding experiences, streaks, quests, progression systems, reactivation flows, and other lifecycle initiatives.

- Take new growth opportunities from first hypothesis to go/no-go decision, across product, market expansion, partnerships, and distribution.

- Lead a high-quality experimentation process by defining hypotheses, designing statistically sound A/B tests, interpreting results, and making data-driven product decisions.

- Partner closely with your dedicated Data Analyst to uncover opportunities, validate assumptions, and continuously improve product performance.

- Work with Engineering, Design, Commercial, User Acquisition, Customer Support, Fraud, and Leadership to align priorities and deliver impactful product improvements.

- Represent your product domain directly to leadership, using data, customer insights, and business context to influence strategic decisions.

What Success Looks Like:

- You take ownership quickly: Within your first months, you've become the trusted owner of a critical product domain, confidently driving priorities, making decisions, and reducing dependency on leadership.

- Growth metrics measurably improve: Your product strategy and experimentation drive meaningful improvements in activation, retention, and long-term user profitability.

- Product decisions are driven by data: Experiments, user insights, and product analytics provide clear evidence to prioritize opportunities, validate ideas, and confidently decide what to scale - or stop.

- Cross-functional teams are aligned around outcomes: You partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and User Acquisition to deliver product improvements that balance user value with business impact.

- You turn ambitious ideas into scalable growth: Through structured experimentation, clear prioritization, and continuous optimization, you build product experiences that become repeatable growth levers for the business.

- You outgrow the role: We are hiring for the ceiling, not just the opening. This role is scoped to grow - mentoring other product managers first, and leading a product team as we scale, if that is the direction you want to take.

What You Bring

- Experienced: You bring 5+ years of Product Management experience in consumer-facing digital products, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, marketplaces, subscriptions, ad-tech, fintech, or other high-growth B2C businesses. You have owned consumer product at scale - hundreds of thousands of monthly active users or more.

- Business-Oriented: You understand that product decisions are business decisions. You're comfortable balancing user needs, commercial objectives, and technical constraints to maximize long-term value.

- Fluent in Incentives: You have a real feel for why people come back and what makes a reward feel worth the effort. You have designed incentive, reward or progression mechanics and calibrated them so they motivate without eroding margin.

- Experimentation-Driven: You have extensive experience running A/B tests, defining hypotheses, interpreting data, and making evidence-based product decisions. Statistical thinking comes naturally to you.

- Data-Literate: You're comfortable working with product metrics and collaborating closely with analysts to uncover insights, measure success, and prioritize opportunities.

- Strategic & Hands-on: You enjoy defining product strategy while remaining deeply involved in execution - from writing specifications and refining solutions to reviewing experiment results and driving delivery.

- Collaborative: You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Commercial, and Leadership, bringing people together around clear product goals.

- Intellectually Honest: You're comfortable working in ambiguity, take ownership without waiting for direction, and thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve quickly. You also kill your own ideas when the data says so - being wrong early is cheaper than being right late.

How We Win

- Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

- Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.

- See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.

- Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.

- Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

Als Atlassian Consultant begleitest du Banken und Finanzdienstleister von der Plattformstrategie bis zum Go-live in der Cloud. - Migrationsplanung & -durchführung: Cloud-Readiness-Assessment, App-Analyse und -Bereinigung, Wellen- und Cutover-Planung, Migration mit JCMA/CCMA – im Takt von Change-Freeze-Zeiten und Vier-Augen-Prinzip der Bank.

- Prüfungsfeste Dokumentation: Migrationsprotokolle, Datenintegritätsnachweise und Berechtigungskonzepte für Revision und Aufsicht.

- Beratung auf Augenhöhe: Du moderierst Workshops mit Entscheidern und Kontrollfunktionen und übersetzt technische Optionen in fundierte Entscheidungsvorlagen.

Qualifikation

- Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Atlassian-Beratung oder -Administration im Enterprise-Umfeld.

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit mindestens einer komplexen Server-/Data-Center-→-Cloud-Migration.

- Solides Verständnis von DORA, MaRisk/BAIT, EBA-Leitlinien zu Auslagerungen und DSGVO. Du musst kein Jurist sein, aber die Fragen der Compliance-Abteilung beantworten können.

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Jira, Confluence und Jira Service Management, idealerweise auch Atlassian Cloud Enterprise und Atlassian Guard.

- Hands-on-Mentalitä t: Du konfigurierst selbst und wartest nicht darauf, dass jemand anderes die Umsetzung übernimmt.

- Ein Plus: Atlassian-Zertifizierungen (oder die Motivation, diese zu erwerben), Erfahrung mit ISO 27001 oder IT-Revisionen, ITIL/ITSM, Scripting (Groovy, Python, REST).

Benefits

title: Mid Market Account Executive - DACH
description:
Who we are 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

About the role:
Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers. 

While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from € 10k to € 300k , selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world : Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

- Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting : The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.

- You have innate curiosity in how businesses work : One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

- You are a life-long learner : Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.

- You build genuine relationships with your customers : The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.

- You want to be with the best : Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

- 

- Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.

- Get In Early: The DACH Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now. 

- Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.

Minimum Requirements for the role:

- Winning DNA: Min.18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.

- Over-achievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment

- Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt

- Native German language speakers

Advantageous:

- Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.

- A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.

- A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.

- Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity 

We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers 

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here .

title: Sales & Consulting Manager B2B (m/w/d)
description:
DIU ist führender IT-Dienstleister mit einer über 25-jährigen Tradition. An unseren zwei Büro-Standorten in Hamburg und Wiesbaden sowie deutschlandweit remote entwickeln und integrieren wir IT-Lösungen auf höchstem Niveau.

Zu unseren langjährigen Kunden zählen unter anderem OTTO, R+V Versicherung, Allianz Trade, Suzuki, Deutsche Telekom oder dpv Deutscher Pressevertrieb.

DIU ist geprägt von einer Kultur der Innovation und des Glaubens an die Kraft von Technologien als zentraler Baustein für den Erfolg von Unternehmen. Gestalte jetzt mit uns die Zukunft der IT getreu unseres Mottos: Unleash your power in IT.

Mehr zu uns bei DIU findest du hier: www.diu.digital/ 

Aufgaben

WANTED 

Wir glauben fest daran, dass gute Beziehungen der Kern für nachhaltige Erfolge sind – besonders im Mittelstand. Für den Aufbau und die operative Weiterentwicklung unserer Kundengewinnung im MarTech-Umfeld suchen wir daher einen Sales & Consulting Manager B2B (m/w/d) – jemanden, der Vertrieb nicht als Zahlenspiel versteht, sondern als Beziehungsarbeit.

Wir schreiben die Position im Raum Hamburg im Hybrid-Modell mit 1-2 Tagen Office je Woche aus. Dein Team ist auf die Standorte Hamburg und Wiesbaden (und Umgebung) verteilt und arbeitet schon länger in dieser Besetzung zusammen, denn wir stellen Teams nach Fachgebiet und Interesse zusammen - nicht nach Wohnort. Um die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie zu stärken ist die Stelle sowohl in Voll- als auch Teilzeit z.B. in einer 4-Tage-Woche ausfüllbar.

DOINGS 

- Du verantwortest den gesamten Kundendialog – von der Erstansprache über die technische und fachliche Bedarfsanalyse bis zur Übergabe ins Projektteam

- Du führst Erst- und Discovery-Gespräche, in denen du gezielt nachfragst, um sowohl die technische Ausgangslage (Systeme, Datenflüsse, bestehende MarTech-Tools) als auch das dahinterliegende Business-Problem unserer Ansprechpartner:innen zu verstehen

- Du identifizierst relevante Unternehmen aus Handel, Versicherung und weiteren Branchen mit komplexen Content- und Marketing-Prozessen und sprichst Entscheider:innen in Marketing, IT und Digital gezielt an

- Du baust und pflegst ein Netzwerk aus Empfehlungen, Partnern und bestehenden Kundenbeziehungen und ergänzt es durch gezielte Direktansprache

- Du setzt KI-gestützte Automatisierung für Zielgruppenanalyse, Lead-Qualifizierung und CRM-Pflege ein, statt Vertrieb rein manuell zu betreiben

- Du koordinierst Termine mit Geschäftsführung und Consultants, bereitest Kundengespräche inhaltlich vor und behältst Follow-ups im Blick

- Du entwickelst Vertriebs- und Beratungsmaterialien mit – von der Positionierung bis zur kundenspezifischen Präsentation

- Du spielst Kundenfeedback aus Erstgesprächen direkt ins Consulting- und Projektteam, damit unsere Lösungsvorschläge von Anfang an treffsicher sind

Qualifikation

KNOWHOW 

- 2–5 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, Consulting, Partner Management oder Business Development, idealerweise im MarTech-, Software- oder IT-Umfeld

- Technisches Grundverständnis für digitale Marketing- und Content-Prozesse (Marketing Automation, Content-Management, Schnittstellen/APIs) und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen authentisch und klar zu vermitteln

- Du hörst genau hin und kannst aus einem Gespräch sowohl das technische Problem als auch das dahinterliegende Business-Anliegen herausarbeiten – dir reicht "wir brauchen ein neues Tool" nicht als Antwort

- Freude an ehrlicher Kommunikation, vertrauensvoller Zusammenarbeit und persönlichem Beziehungsaufbau statt reinem "Abschluss-Denken"

- Hohe Selbstorganisation, Strukturdenken und Umsetzungskompetenz – gute Vorbereitung und verlässliche Follow-ups sind für dich selbstverständlich

- Intrinsische Motivation und echtes Interesse, gemeinsam mit dem Team nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen und hohe Zufriedenheit zu erzielen

- Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

DIU FOR YOU 

Bei DIU besetzen wir nicht Stellen, sondern suchen nach Menschen mit Leidenschaft für ihr Fachgebiet. Wir verstehen uns als Plattform für ein Team aus Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft mit anderen teilen oder in Projekte einbringen möchten. Den Rahmen für diese Arbeit schaffen wir mit:

- Deinem eigenen Weiterbildungs-Budget

- Zertifizierungen und Weiterbildungen Deiner Wahl

- Einer agilen Unternehmensorganisation

- Einer offenen Fehler- und Gesprächskultur

- Einbeziehung tiefer fachlicher Themen in Management-Entscheidungen

DIU SPIRIT 

Wir sind nicht laut - sondern lieber unaufgeregt und verlässlich. Wir entwickeln DIU bewusst strukturiert weiter. Bei uns findest du:

- Sehr durchmischte Altersstrukturen

- Eine gute und geregelte Gehaltsstruktur

- Fachabteilungen für unsere Kerntechnologien / Gleichgesinnte

- Moderne technische Infrastruktur und Tools

- Teilzeitmodelle unterschiedlicher Art

GET IN 

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung, selbst wenn dein Profil nicht exakt auf die Beschreibung passt. Bewirb dich jetzt einfach und unkompliziert über das Bewerbungsformular und unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins sowie deiner Gehaltsvorstellungen.

Dabei verbinden wir operatives Anpacken mit dem Anspruch, unsere Zusammenarbeit und unsere Abläufe kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Aktuell wechseln wir von Personio zu SAP HCM – ein wichtiger Schritt für unser Team und für die Art, wie wir unsere People-Prozesse gestalten. Hier kommst Du ins Spiel: Als unser:e (Mid–Senior) People Operations Manager:in übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für alle People Operations Themen in Deinem festen Betreuungsbereich, begleitest die Einführung von SAP HCM und hilfst uns, den Übergang für das gesamte Team so reibungslos wie möglich zu gestalten. Deine Aufgaben: 

- Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für alle People Operations Themen in Deinem festen Betreuungsbereich und bist eine verlässliche Ansprechperson für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte.

- Du hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse, erkennst Möglichkeiten zur Vereinfachung und setzt deine Ideen in pragmatische und nachhaltige Lösungen um.

- Du behältst Änderungen im Arbeitsrecht und Best Practices im People-Operations-Bereich im Blick und leitest daraus klare Maßnahmen für bonial ab.

Stellenanforderungen

- Du bringst umfangreiche Berufserfahrung in People Operations, HR-Administration oder einer vergleichbaren generalistischen HR-Rolle mit.

- Du arbeitest selbstständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Struktur und einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch in deine Themen.

- Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (min. C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse (min. B2), sodass Du auch in unserem internationalen Umfeld sicher zusammenarbeiten kannst.

- Du verfügst über fundierte und aktuelle Kenntnisse im deutschen Arbeitsrecht sowie praktische Erfahrung in der vorbereitenden Gehaltsabrechnung.

- Idealerweise hast du bereits eine HR-Systemeinführung, eine Prozessmigration oder ein vergleichbares Transformationsprojekt begleitet. Erfahrung mit SAP HCM ist ein großes Plus.

Was wir Dir bieten können:

High-Growth Story – bonial ist ein wachstumsstarkes und dynamisches Unternehmen mit dauerhaftem Potenzial für die Zukunft. Wir sind eines der führenden Unternehmen und eine treibende Kraft in einer Branche, die gerade einen massiven, einmaligen Wandel von Print zu Digital erlebt.

Innovation & Tech – Wir sind ein High-Tech-Unternehmen mit Fokus auf innovative Technologien. Wir nutzen KI und andere Tools, um Produktivität und Effizienz zu steigern. Damit verbessern wir kontinuierlich die Leistung unseres Unternehmens und aller, die hier arbeiten – und erzielen gleichzeitig Ergebnisse für unsere Kund:innen und Nutzer:innen.

Spannendes Umfeld für Deine berufliche Entwicklung – Wir unterstützen Dich stark in Deiner beruflichen Entwicklung, gestützt von einer Feedback-Kultur, die Dir hilft, Deine Stärken und Chancen zu erkennen.

Wir setzten uns für gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten ein, und dafür, ein Safe Space zu sein unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Behinderung, Gender, Geschlechtsidentität oder Geschlechtsausdruck.

Wohlbefinden - Für uns ist mentale Gesundheit genauso wichtig wie Fitness. Deshalb bieten wir Dir einen kostenlosen Zugang zu nilo.health, einer App für mentale Gesundheit, an. Außerdem brauchst Du Dir keine Sorgen um Deine Rente machen, denn wir bezuschussen Deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Zusätzlich zu unserem internen Fitnesstudio, übernehmen wir auch einen Teil der Kosten für Urban Sports Club.

Nachhaltigkeit - Dir liegt das Thema Nachhaltigkeit am Herzen? Uns auch! Zusammen mit unserem Green Team bieten wir Dir die Möglichkeit, Dich in Projekten zu Nachhaltigkeit und Umweltschutz zu engagieren. Gemeinsam wollen wir unseren Beitrag leisten und den Planeten so positiv beeinflussen, wie wir nur können.

Flexibilität – Aktuell haben wir eine Regelung, die wöchentlich bis zu 20% mobiles Arbeiten innerhalb Deutschlands ermöglicht. Dazu darfst Du 30 Tage pro Jahr aus dem Ausland arbeiten. Zusätzlich bieten wir 28 Urlaubstage. Pro Kalenderjahr kommen ein weiterer Urlaubstag hinzu (bis zu maximal 30 Tage) sowie zusätzliche freie Tage für besondere Anlässe (z. B. Umzug, Mitarbeit an einem sozialen Projekt etc.).*

Modernes Büro - Wir haben ein eigenes und voll ausgestattetes Fitnessstudio, eine Dachterrasse für Team Events und Mittagspausen in der Sonne, sowie Zen Rooms, in denen Mitarbeitende beten, entspannen oder einfach eine ruhige Minute finden können.

Kostenloses Mittagessen - Wenn Du im Büro bist, bieten wir Dir verschiedene Optionen für ein Mittagessen an, und das Mittagessen geht auf uns! Du kannst in dem nahliegenden Partner-Restaurant essen gehen! Natürlich sind auch heiße sowie kalte Getränke, Obst und andere Snacks im Büro für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen kostenlos.*

Soziale Kultur - Ein gutes Miteinander ist uns wichtig, weshalb wir Wert auf eine Kultur legen, die dazu einlädt, miteinander ins Gespräch zu kommen, gute Arbeitsbeziehungen aufzubauen und sich gemeinschaftlich an Projekten zu beteiligen. Wir bieten außerdem regelmäßig optionale Events an, um dies weiter zu unterstützen.

Partner für den Handel – Wir ermöglichen es Händler:innen, ihre Kund:innen auf die effizienteste und wirkungsvollste Weise zu erreichen. Wir sehen uns als wichtigen Geschäftspartner für den Handel und – wie in unserer Unternehmensvision betont – „Bereichern wir das lokale Einkaufen für alle. Jeden Tag.“

Als Teil der Axel Springer Gruppe orientieren wir uns zusätzlich an den .

Hört sich das gut an für Dich? Wir freuen uns von Dir zu hören!

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
SingleStore is looking for an accomplished sales professional to join our Sales Team. AI is moving from experimentation into production, and this role is an opportunity to break into AI while doing meaningful enterprise selling.

As an Account Executive, AI Hunter, your job is simple: create new SingleStore customers. You will find companies building AI applications where data access, real-time context, memory, retrieval, or operational scale is becoming a constraint—and turn those challenges into new SingleStore customers. You will own a broad territory, build a majority self-sourced pipeline, create demand in an emerging category, and close greenfield enterprise opportunities.

This is a true hunting role. You will engage customers before they have a defined project, develop customer-specific points of view, create urgency around business and technical problems, work with technical experts to land first production workloads, and build a measurable new-logo business with broad ownership. The ideal candidate is a measurable enterprise hunter who is competitive, curious, technically credible, resilient, and able to sell business outcomes. Direct AI sales experience is valuable, but proven selling ability and technical curiosity matter more than a narrow “AI seller” title.

Role and Responsibilities

- Build and execute a territory strategy for net-new customer acquisition.

- Prospect fearlessly across a broad account universe using proactive, persistent outbound, account-based, partner, and market-education motions; stay resilient and effective through rejection and ambiguity.

- Form account hypotheses, map the buying center, and earn first meetings with relevant points of view tailored to the customer.

- Engage executive, business, technical, security, and procurement stakeholders.

- Lead great business-first discovery, connect AI and data challenges to fundable goals, and build quantified ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.

- Build and develop champions, multi-thread the buying group, earn executive and economic-buyer access, and maintain stakeholder alignment; own the stakeholder plan, mutual action plan, close plan, value case, stage gates, forecast, and commercial outcome.

- Lead complex sales cycles through technical validation, security, legal, procurement, negotiation, and close.

- Partner with Solutions and Forward Deployment Engineers and cross-functional teams to validate technical fit and establish the first production workload.

- Navigate competitive displacement and maintain disciplined activity management, CRM hygiene, reporting, qualification, forecasting, and opportunity management; showcase clear metrics such as pipeline created, meetings, conversion, quota attainment, and new-logo performance.

- Be AI fluent: use AI and research tools productively and responsibly while applying judgment, validating outputs, and separating facts from hypotheses.

- Travel within the assigned territory as required. 

Required Skills and Experience

- 5+ years of quota-carrying B2B enterprise software sales experience, ideally selling to large or technically sophisticated organizations; experience in data, cloud, analytics, AI, or adjacent technical domains is a plus.

- Repeated, quantified quota success with clear ownership of new-logo wins and self-sourced pipeline.

- Experience closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving executives, technical evaluators, security, legal, finance, procurement, and partners.

- Ability to sell measurable business outcomes and build ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.

- Technical fluency in an adjacent domain such as databases, data infrastructure, analytics, AI/ML, cloud, Kubernetes, developer tools, cybersecurity, observability, or open-source software.

- Strong qualification, account planning, forecasting, CRM, negotiation, and deal-management skills.

- Learning velocity and coachability, demonstrated through specific behavior change after feedback; ability to explain technical concepts clearly to technical and executive audiences.

- Executive presence, customer trust, resilience, intellectual honesty, and excellent communication skills.

- B.A., B.S. degree or equivalent in a related field.

- Experience with Fortune 500 or security-sensitive organizations, cloud ecosystems, open-source or consumption-based products, or emerging categories is preferred.

XTX Markets has an unrivalled level of computational resources in the trading industry, with a growing research cluster currently containing well over 25,000 GPUs with more than 1 exabyte of usable storage. Teams across the firm include world-class researchers, developers and technologists with backgrounds in pure math, programming, physics, computer science and machine learning. The firm is also constructing a large-scale data centre in Finland to future-proof its significant computational capabilities. 

At XTX Markets technology is our business and we are a diverse organization which attracts outstanding talent from across all industry backgrounds. We are focused on teamwork and our people collaborate on all aspects of the business, working openly and with respect for each other, our clients and the market. Our culture is non-hierarchical and one where everyone is valued. We strive for excellence in everything we do. 

The Role 

Shared Engineering is a mixed-discipline platform team of around a dozen engineers (network engineers, Linux engineers, and software developers). The team owns the foundations that the firm's engineering runs on such as alerting, job scheduling, host inventory/monitoring, and the internal developer tooling for our monorepo. This includes shared libraries, build systems and CI/CD infrastructure. 

Our aim is to give the firm's engineers leverage: fewer manual steps, delivery that is fast and predictable, and teams who can self-serve rather than raising a ticket and waiting. We have many initiatives in flight at once, so judgement about which thing to work on matters nearly as much as building it well. 

This is a software-developer role on the team focused on developer experience and platform software: building the tools, services, and libraries that make everyone else's engineering faster and more reliable. A growing part of that remit is how the firm's engineers adopt AI and coding-assistant tooling. Recent work includes our self-service network configuration tools, sandboxing and gateway services for coding assistants, and pulling host inventory data into a single source of truth. 

Responsibilities 

- Working primarily in Go, build and own platform services and internal tooling end-to-end, from design through to production.

- Help shape how the wider firm adopts AI/coding-assistant tooling safely and effectively, integrating it into workflows and building guardrails and tooling around it. 

- Collaborate with the network and Linux engineers to understand what the infrastructure needs in order to scale and be managed, then expose it cleanly in software. 

- Mentor and share knowledge, improving teammates' skills and making sure others can maintain and build on the systems you develop. 

- Review and raise standards by thoughtful code review, sensible judgement on where to block versus where to let things flow, and a pragmatic sense of the right work to be doing right now.

Essential attributes 

- Strong software-engineering fundamentals and production experience owning services end-to-end. Go is what you'd write day to day, but we care more about the fundamentals than the language: strong backgrounds in other statically typed languages are welcome. 

- Comfortable on Linux, with an understanding of the OS your software runs on (processes, networking basics, packaging, systemd), even if you're not a systems engineer.

Things we'd like to see. You won't have all of them, and that's fine.

title: Senior Radar Systems Engineer
description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats. 

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com .

Role Overview: 

You’ll join the systems engineering team working across London and Los Angeles, in support of deployments of our radars across Europe and the Middle East.

Our Mission team deploys and operates the systems on customer sites; you own how they perform. You’ll build deep expertise in how our radars behave in the real world, and turn data from live deployments and field testing into tuning, calibration, and product improvements.

What You’ll Do: 

- Deployed Performance - own radar performance for systems in the field. Diagnose RF, detection, and tracking problems on live deployments, and turn what you find into concrete fixes.

- Tuning & Calibration - calibrate, configure, and tune radar modes for the environments we operate in, and become the expert on how our products behave in the real world.

- Performance Analysis - characterise detection, tracking, and false-alarm performance against truth data. Quantify what the system does and find where it falls short.

- Field Testing - plan and lead test campaigns and data collections, then analyse the results and turn the findings into product improvements.

- Tooling & Enablement - build the tooling, diagnostics, and playbooks that let Mission team engineers independently deploy, tune, and troubleshoot in the field, using AI coding tools to build and ship faster than a team your size otherwise could.

- Systems Engineering - contribute to requirements, specifications, and acceptance criteria across both sides of the V, grounded in what you’ve seen deployed.

What We’re Looking For: 

We’re looking for engineers with real depth in radar who are excited by hard technical problems and systems that matter. You don’t need every specialism listed below - we value strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly.

You’ll thrive in this role if you: 

- Have several years of hands-on radar systems experience, with a deep understanding of radar principles and modes.

- Understand the signal processing chain well enough to reason about it end to end - waveform design, matched filtering, Doppler processing, detection, and clutter rejection.

- Have hands-on experience calibrating RF systems and measuring their performance.

- Enjoy digging into radar data to work out why a system behaves the way it does.

- Are fluent in Python.

- Are AI-native - you reach for coding agents and AI tools by default, get real leverage from them, and have a considered view on what to delegate to them and what not to.

- Bring systems engineering experience with RF systems, across both sides of the V.

- Are comfortable working in the field, on customer sites, and under operational pressure.

- Communicate well with people outside your own discipline, technical or not.

Requirements: 

- Right to work in the UK.

- Willingness to travel. You’ll be based in our Soho office in London.

- Expect to travel around 25% of the time, in blocks around deployments and test campaigns across Europe and the Middle East, plus time co-locating with the systems engineering team in Los Angeles.

- Eligible for UK security clearance.

Why CHAOS? 

- Health Benefits: private medical, dental and vision benefits (for employees & dependents) will be 100% paid for by the company

- Additional benefits : 5% pension match, life insurance, Cycle to Work Scheme, and more

- Our Perks: Free daily lunch, ‘No meeting Fridays’, unlimited PTO, casual dress code

- Compensation Components: competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance + annual bonuses

- Team Growth: 350+ employees and counting across 5 global offices

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai .

The Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join ExTrac's AI team, building Co-Analyst and the analytical AI features around it.

Co-Analyst is a user-facing multi-agent system that works alongside intelligence analysts to research and write reports. Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

title: Product Lead
description:
About us 

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production.

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

The role 

Encord is a fast-growing company building the data infrastructure layer for AI teams. We work with leading enterprises across autonomous vehicles, healthcare, robotics, and generative AI. Our product team is small, high-calibre, and operating in green-field territory. The data layer for AI is still being defined, and you will help define it.

As Product Lead, you will own a meaningful slice of the product, spanning the core platform experience, data curation and exploration layer, and drive it from strategy through to customer outcomes. You will lead and grow a team of Product Managers, setting direction, raising the bar on craft, and multiplying your impact through them. You will work closely with Engineering, ML, Design, and Customer Success, and play an active role in Encord's enterprise go-to-market motion.

This is a high-autonomy role for someone who is comfortable making independent decisions and driving them through, and who can build a team that does the same.

The Opportunity: Just as LLMs were unlocked by massive text datasets, the next wave of breakthroughs in self-driving vehicles, robotics, drones and generative AI requires building entirely new datasets and human feedback pipelines that don't yet exist. Encord is the platform the world's most ambitious AI teams use to build them, and you'll be helping define what that platform looks like.

Hard and Complex Problems: There is no playbook for what the data layer for AI looks like. You'll be solving novel problems across your product areas: from core platform (tooling that scales from a 10-person startup to a 500-person AV team) to data curation (helping customers turn floods of raw data into high-signal training datasets).

Ownership and Growth: Product is represented at the highest levels at Encord. You'll have real ownership: setting strategy, making calls, driving them through, and building the team that executes. As one of the most senior product people in the company, your impact is visible and your trajectory is accelerated.

What you'll do 

- Own and manage the product roadmap across your areas, ensuring alignment with company goals, KPIs, and enterprise customer needs

- Manage, coach, and develop Product Managers: setting clear goals, giving regular feedback, reviewing their specs and decisions, and accelerating their growth.

- Set the standard for product craft across the team: discovery, prioritisation, spec quality, and shipping cadence

- Lead customer discovery, interviews, problem validation, webinars, and demos, translating complex pain points into clear, winning product bets

- Partner with Sales and Customer Success to drive upsell, cross-sell, and expansion within our largest enterprise accounts

- Collaborate with Engineering and Design to ship high-quality features at pace, writing tight specs, making clear tradeoffs, and holding a high bar for what ships

- Play a leading role in building a high-performing, collaborative product management culture as the team grows

Experience requirements 

- Experience in product, ideally including time at a rapidly scaling startup. You have seen an organisation scale and know what good product looks like at each stage

- Experience managing or formally mentoring other product managers, or a clear track record of leading through others and a strong desire to step into people management

- Proven experience on B2B SaaS products or technical products sold to enterprise customers. You understand the enterprise sales motion, expansion, and how product decisions connect to revenue

- You speak in metrics and impact, not features shipped. You have worked closely with GTM teams and can tie product decisions to business outcomes

- A self-starter who makes independent decisions and drives them through. You want ownership, not just input. You are energised by ambiguity, not paralysed by it

- You love speaking to customers. You are curious about hard problems at the frontier of AI, and you anticipate needs before customers can fully articulate them

- Excellent communication skills for leading internal sessions and external engagements, customer interviews, demos, and stakeholder presentations

Encord encourages people from all backgrounds, cultures, and skill levels to apply. You don't need to meet every requirement. We are looking for people who are passionate, customer-focused, and eager to learn. 

Why Encord 

- Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

- Strong in-person culture - most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

- 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

- Annual learning & development budget

- Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

- Company lunches twice a week

- Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites

title: Senior Engineer - High Performance Data Systems
description:
About Encord 

Encord is the universal data layer for AI. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates and evaluates multimodal data across the full AI lifecycle, from development to production, for 300+ AI teams including Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath and Zipline.

Encord was founded by former computer scientists, physicists and quants who saw first-hand how poor tooling for training data slows AI progress. We're a Series C company backed by CRV and Y Combinator, with 150+ people across London, San Francisco and New York.

The role 

Most engineers never get to redesign core infrastructure for the next 100x of scale. On Foundations, that's the job. 

AI teams are generating video, images, 3D sensor data and documents faster than anyone's systems can keep up. Help us build the high-performance data systems behind the AI data platform for robotics and beyond.

You'll join Foundations, the backend backbone of Encord. We build the reliable, scalable, fast systems every other team and every customer runs on. The work sits deep in distributed and data-intensive systems: storage, indexing, querying and processing multimodal data at a scale few companies ever reach.

title: Senior AI/ML Software Engineer
description:
About Nabla 

We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine.

Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day.

We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows.

Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere.

This is a great time to join us!

The best of AI at the service of healthcare 

Led by former Meta AI Research engineers, our team has consistently anticipated how AI can revolutionize healthcare delivery. Our Machine Learning team continually leverages the latest advancements to unlock AI’s full potential in healthcare.

Yann LeCun, Meta’s ex-Chief AI Scientist and Turing award winner, is an advisor to Nabla. He’s now focused on AMI Labs, with whom we have a close partnership.

Engineering at Nabla 

Engineering at Nabla is lean, fast-moving, and deeply technical. Our teams span machine learning, native desktop applications, and platform infrastructure to deliver AI into clinical settings reliably and at scale.

Your Team 

At Nabla, product development is led jointly by Engineering and Product, and organized into cross-functional squads, each focused on a specific product area. Squads bring together product managers, designers, engineers of different profiles, and domain experts, and operate with a high level of ownership.

As an AI Engineer, you’ll join one of these squads and contribute end to end to a specific part of the product.

What you'll do 

As an AI/ML Software Engineer, you’ll play a key role in redefining clinicians’ workflows, unlocking better care for patients, and ensuring Nabla remains at the forefront of AI innovation. You will take ownership of high-impact projects and contribute to the growth and maturity of our engineering team and product.

Within a team of experts who have built large-scale production systems at Meta, Google, and Microsoft, you will:

- Build agentic pipelines: chains of LLM-based agents that work together on complex clinical documentation tasks.

- Go beyond ambient scribing to fully redefine clinicians’ workflows with AI, unlocking transformative efficiencies and improved patient care.

- Integrate LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others) into production features.

- Design prompts and build evaluation frameworks to measure and improve output quality, then iterate quickly based on results.

- Write clean, production-grade code and own your features end to end, from design to deployment and monitoring in a live healthcare setting.

- Work closely with product managers to turn model capabilities into reliable, scalable product features.

To get a sense of the impact you’ll have: 

- Nabla processes 300 billion tokens/month with LLMs.

- By the time you’ve read this posting, Nabla will have transcribed 100 new hours of live audio and generated 500 new clinical notes , saving 125 hours of doctor time .

Your DNA: 

The ideal candidate will bring strong software engineering skills and a practical, hands-on approach to building with LLMs.

- You have 3+ years writing production code, with solid skills in software design, testing, and system architecture.

- You’re proficient in one or more widely used back-end languages (Java, Kotlin, C++, Go, etc.).

- You’ve built features or products using LLM provider APIs, including prompting and evaluation. You don’t need to have trained or fine-tuned models yourself.

- You can turn a fuzzy product requirement into a working, testable pipeline.

- You have a passion for going beyond the status quo to redefine workflows and unlock better care for patients.

- You communicate clearly and effectively.

- Bonus: Experience building multi-agent systems or agent orchestration frameworks is a strong plus.

Our Stack 

- Kotlin for backend services

- LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, and others) for the models themselves

- Agent orchestration frameworks for building chains of agents

- Prompt evaluation and testing tools to track output quality over time

- Google Cloud & Kubernetes for deployment

Where you'll be based 

Our offices are based in Paris 3e (Arts & Métiers) .
Remote policy: 1-2 days a week (with some flexibility). Possibility of working remotely 1-2 weeks once a year.

Benefits 

Just like we’re dedicated to supporting doctors’ well-being, ensuring yours is a top priority. We firmly believe that by prioritizing your well-being, we support you to excel in your work.

Here are the benefits you get when joining Nabla:

- Stock ownership

- 100% healthcare coverage

- Meal vouchers

- Public transportation costs covered at 50%

- Exercise class during the workday: Yoga, running, pilates, HIIT

- Unlimited budget for book purchases, so you can continue to learn about ML / Healthcare

- Culture of trust & accountability — your output matters more than your clock-in time

Life at Nabla 

When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed.

We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes.

We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts!

If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application!

Our Values at Nabla 

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel 

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble 

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift 

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity 

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion 

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment scam which is now using Nabla to collect personal information or financial scams. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure whomever is contacting you truly represents Nabla and is utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity from people who could be pretending to be recruiters or senior professionals at Nabla. You can find more information following this link .

Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.
