The Role: 

We are looking for a Principal Engineer to own the classical cryptography architecture of our post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration products, targeting hardware security module (HSM) and network-appliance applications. Real-world quantum-safe systems are hybrid systems: classical and post-quantum algorithms operating side by side, with careful key management, crypto agility and migration paths. You will be the senior authority for this classical and hybrid layer, working alongside our PQC architecture leadership. The role demands fluency on both sides of the transition: deep classical mastery combined with a solid working command of the post-quantum algorithms and standards the products are built around.

Responsibilities :

You will own the architecture and implementation strategy of the classical cryptographic functions of the product line: symmetric ciphers and modes (AES/GCM and beyond), hash functions (SHA-2/SHA-3, HMAC/KDF constructions), RSA/ECC offload, and true random number generation and entropy architecture (SP 800-90A/B/C). You will define the hybrid classical/post-quantum schemes (key establishment, dual signatures, composite certificates) and the crypto-agility mechanisms that allow customers to migrate safely, track the standardisation of hybrid and composite approaches (NIST guidance, IETF work on hybrid key establishment in TLS 1.3 and IKEv2, composite certificates) together with our PQC architects, guide RTL and software engineers implementing classical cores, technically evaluate third-party IP, and support FIPS 140-3 and CAVP certification of the classical algorithm suite. You will also own key-management and key-hierarchy architecture across the product, ensuring interoperability with deployed HSM, TLS and IPsec ecosystems.

- Own the classical and hybrid cryptography architecture of the product line: symmetric, hash, RSA/ECC, entropy and key management, and classical/PQC hybrid schemes

- Define crypto-agility and migration mechanisms that let customers move to quantum-safe deployments without breaking existing infrastructure

Requirements: 

We are looking for a candidate with a Master’s or PhD in Cryptography, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field and at least twelve years of experience implementing and architecting classical cryptography in real products, in hardware, software or both. You have deep command of symmetric and asymmetric primitives, modes of operation, key management and entropy generation, and you have taken cryptographic subsystems through FIPS 140-3 or Common Criteria evaluation. You also bring a solid working knowledge of the NIST post-quantum algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA) and their deployment constraints: you do not need to be a lattice specialist, but you must be able to architect hybrid schemes with one.

You understand the practical constraints of deployed security infrastructure (HSMs, PKI, TLS and IPsec ecosystems) and how hybrid classical/post-quantum schemes are standardised and deployed in practice. You write precise specifications, guide implementers effectively, and make sound architecture decisions under real-world interoperability constraints. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

- Proven architect of classical cryptographic subsystems with certification experience (FIPS 140-3, CAVP, Common Criteria)

- Practical knowledge of hybrid classical/PQC schemes, crypto agility and key-management architecture, with working command of the NIST PQC standards

Preferred Qualifications:

You believe that quantum-safe security is only as strong as the classical foundations it stands on. You enjoy being the guardian of correctness and interoperability in a programme pushing new technology, and you take pride in migrations that customers barely notice because they simply work.

description:

At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development. title: Software Engineer, Platform - Zurich, Switzerland
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity. 

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. 

Overview 

The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.

These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice.

The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast.

What Yo u’ ll Do 

- Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and our public TTS API

- Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break

- Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it correct after you've moved on

- Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that freed you up for

- Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat

- Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us

- Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the product is going

An Ideal Candidate Should Have 

- Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required)

- Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud

- A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it created

- A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended, what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone

- The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual request — rather than against a summary of it

- Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it

- A preference for being corrected over being right

- Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments

- Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes

Interview process 

Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to finish within a week.

The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk through your reasoning, so bring it.

What We Offer 

- A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products

- A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive

- Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity

- The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry

- Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture

- The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more

- An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

The Switzerland Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-160,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

Sales Manager (Account Executive) (Zurich) 

Remote 

Applications to be Submitted in English 

With millions of diners, 60,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the Job 
As an Account Executive in Zurich, you will drive the expansion of our dining network by acquiring new restaurant partners through a consultative sales approach. You will act as a trusted advisor to top restaurants, demonstrating how our industry-leading front-of-house management and online reservation technology can optimize their revenue potential. In this remote position with up to 60% domestic travel, you will play a crucial role in empowering restaurants to focus on their teams and guests. Your strategic efforts will directly influence our market presence and the continued success of the hospitality industry in your territory.

Responsibilities 

- Identify, target, and approach prospective restaurant customers within your assigned territory to drive revenue and consistently exceed acquisition targets.

- Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with elite restaurant partners, acting as a strategic consultant to challenge their business perspectives and offer industry insights.

- Deliver high-quality, customized, data-driven demonstrations of our solutions in person and online to address specific partner needs.

- Develop comprehensive business plans to define selling strategies, overcome competitive objections, and drive long-term business value.

- Utilise Salesforce effectively to manage your territory, forecast sales activity, process contracts, and stay organized.

- Gather and present valuable customer feedback to product and marketing teams while maintaining visibility in the hospitality industry through networking.

Minimum Qualifications 

- 5+ years of experience in business-to-business (B2B) enterprise sales.

- Native-level proficiency in Swiss German and business-level proficiency in English.

- Native Italian or French proficiency is a plus!

- Proven track record of goal-oriented sales performance, including outbound lead generation and pipeline management.

- Proficiency with CRM software (such as Salesforce) and Google Workspace.

- Ability to work independently in a remote environment with up to 60% domestic travel.

Preferred Qualifications 

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

- Prior restaurant management or sales experience within the food and beverage industry.

- Strong ability to leverage data and analytics to inform strategic decision-making and build compelling business cases.

- Exceptional time management, discovery, and negotiation skills.

- A highly collaborative, team-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous learning and
hospitality technology.

Benefits and Perks 

- Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday:

- 25 days of paid vacation

- Additional paid time off for key life moments, including your wedding and moving day

- Paid volunteer time

- Paid parental leave

- Pension plan contributions

- Supplemental accident insurance

- Health insurance subsidy of 250 CHF per month

- Lunch-Check Card of 180 CHF per month

- Access to Swibeco discounts and perks

- Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

- Focus on mental health and well-being:

- Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

- Company-paid subscription to Headspace

- Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

- Focus on your career growth:

- Development Dollars

- Leadership development

- Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

- Travel Discounts

- Employee Resource Groups

Work Environment & Flexibility 

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

Inclusion 

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.

title: Enterprise Account Manager
description:
Position Overview: 

As an Account Manager with Diligent, you'll be at the forefront of driving revenue growth, deepening customer engagement, and shaping the future of how businesses utilise our cutting-edge solutions. Success in this role means expanding product adoption among current customers and introducing new clients to our platform. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role that demands strategic vision, proactive relationship-building, and relentless pursuit of excellence. You’ll be responsible for everything from engaging prospects and managing a robust pipeline to delivering accurate forecasts and closing deals. Acting as a trusted advisor and strategist, you’ll lead account planning, orchestrate internal collaboration, and leverage expertise to elevate customer success and revenue growth. 

We’re looking for a commercially sound sales professional with a track record of exceeding targets, a natural collaborator, and someone who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments. If you’re driven to create value, embody a customer-first ethos, and deliver innovative solutions, this is the role for you. 

What you will get: 

- Uncapped commission plan with accelerators 

- Be part of a high performing, high attainment team and culture 

- Defined territory with existing customer base 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Proactively build a deep knowledge of and expertise in Diligent’s products, solutions, strategy and business priorities. 

- Responsible for expanding existing business within the designated vertical / territory for complex accounts. 

- Adopts a ‘solutions’ selling approach, understanding customer needs and developing solutions through the lens of the Diligent One Platform. 

- Build deep relationships with prospects and customers during interactions by being customer-focused and consistently honouring commitments and connecting the customer to internal commercial stakeholders to foster product growth. 

- Develop and execute on account plans to ensure revenue targets, quota and customer business needs are met and collaborates with key stakeholders to drive integrated joint account wins for mutual business growth. 

- Leads the coordination of Sales stakeholders to prioritise actions for multiple assigned accounts based on customer needs, sales generating importance, and account risks. 

- Develops specialised business plans for customers that drive business outcomes to generate new business and upsells. Presents business plans to customers to generate new non-qualified opportunities. 

- Create and lead feedback loop processes with product management and product marketing to communicate and relay customer pain points and feedback. 

- Demonstrate Sales excellence by managing the end-to-end sales cycle from opportunity to deal close using the Diligent approved sales methodology. 

- Effectively utilise sales tools to prospect new leads, schedule initial meetings, increase win rates and generate bookings. 

- Accurately maintain SFDC records, forecast and report out on projected bookings, deals closed etc. on a regular basis. 

- Demonstrates a deep understanding of the competitor landscape externally, including customers’ business strategy and the direction of the industry. 

Required Experience/Skills: 

- 4+ years of success in account management, new business acquisition, and exceeding revenue targets, ideally within highly regulated industries, SaaS or GRC space. 

- Proven experience in sales methodologies such as MEDDIC, Challenger & Command of the message. 

- The ability to build trust and influence senior leaders and stakeholders at all organisational levels. 

- A passion for continuous learning and a sharp understanding of both internal products and external industry trends. 

- Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills that inspire confidence and drive outcomes. 

- A knack for aligning technology solutions with business objectives to deliver measurable value. 

- Self-motivation, resilience, and a results-driven approach to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. 

About Us 

Diligent is the AI leader in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) SaaS solutions, helping more than 1 million users and 700,000 board members to clarify risk and elevate governance. The Diligent One Platform gives practitioners, the C-Suite and the board a consolidated view of their entire GRC practice so they can more effectively manage risk, build greater resilience and make better decisions, faster. 

At Diligent, we're building the future with people who think boldly and move fast. Whether you're designing systems that leverage large language models or part of a team reimaging workflows with AI, you'll help us unlock entirely new ways of working and thinking. Curiosity is in our DNA, we look for individuals willing to ask the big questions and experiment fearlessly - those who embrace change not as a challenge, but as an opportunity. The future belongs to those who keep learning, and we are building it together. At Diligent, you’re not just building the future - you’re an agent of positive change, joining a global community on a mission to make an impact. 

Learn more at diligent.com or follow us on LinkedIn and Facebook 

What Diligent Offers You 

- Creativity is ingrained in our culture. We are innovative collaborators by nature. We thrive in exploring how things can be differently both in our internal processes and to help our clients

- We care about our people. Diligent offers a flexible work environment, global days of service, comprehensive health benefits, meeting free days, generous time off policy and wellness programs to name a few

- We have teams all over the world . We may be headquartered in New York City, but we have office hubs in Washington D.C., Vancouver, London, Galway, Budapest, Munich, Bengaluru, Singapore, and Sydney.

- Diversity is important to us. Growing, maintaining and promoting a diverse team is a top priority for us. We foster and encourage diversity through our Employee Resource Groups and provide access to resources and education to support the education of our team, facilitate dialogue, and foster understanding.

Diligent created the modern governance movement. Our world-changing idea is to empower leaders with the technology, insights and connections they need to drive greater impact and accountability – to lead with purpose. Our employees are passionate, smart, and creative people who not only want to help build the software company of the future, but who want to make the world a more sustainable, equitable and better place. 

Headquartered in New York, Diligent has offices in Washington D.C., London, Galway, Budapest, Vancouver, Bengaluru, Munich, Singapore and Sydney.  To foster strong collaboration and connection, this role will follow a hybrid work model. If you are within a commuting distance to one of our Diligent office locations, you will be expected to work onsite at least 50% of the time. We believe that in-person engagement helps drive innovation, teamwork, and a strong sense of community.

Diligent is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, pregnancy, childbirth, physical disability, mental disability, age, military status, protected veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner or civil union status, gender (including sex stereotyping and gender identity or expression), medical condition (including, but not limited to, cancer related or HIV/AIDS related), genetic information, or sexual orientation in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Diligent's EEO Policy and US EEOC ’ s Know Your Rights . We are a drug free workplace. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at -----
To support a fair and consistent hiring process, we use AI and digital automated tools to assist our recruitment team in organizing candidate data, surfacing relevant applications, coordinating interview scheduling and summarizing interview notes. All final screening, evaluation, and hiring decisions are made by humans on our team. To learn more about how we collect, protect, and process your information, please review our Candidate Privacy Policy . 

At Diligent, we recognize the value of a diverse global workforce. Visa sponsorship may be available for select positions based on business needs and specific role requirements. Sponsorship decisions are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and eligibility should not be assumed for all opportunities. 

Recruitment agencies: Diligent does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Diligent employees or any other organization location. Diligent is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes

title: Product Engineer
description:
The Context 

Banks still run their most critical, regulated work by hand; reading letters and emails, re-keying data between systems, chasing down missing info. It's the kind of work that's too important to get wrong and too tedious for anyone to want to do.

Porters fixes this. Our AI agents run these regulated processes end to end, with the audit trails and security banks actually require, so the work moves at the speed customers expect instead of the speed a backlog allows.

We're just over a year old and already live with real customers, growing the product quickly, and were named Fintech of the Year 2026. The goal is to build the operating system for autonomous banking. We're backed by Earlybird, one of Europe's oldest venture firms, and Seedcamp, who wrote first checks into Revolut, Wise, and UiPath.

The Mission 

You'll own features in their entirety. Self-standing or with guidance of founders and fellow engineers, you turn a clear problem statement into a strong design and build, test, and ship new features that directly enable our customers. You integrate features across our layered stack, from the API to the data plane, and carry them all the way to production.

This job is in person in Zurich, or remote in Barcelona or Berlin.

Your responsibilities 

- Ship features end-to-end: Deliver complete vertical slices across the stack, from the API layer to the data model, carried through to running in production.

- Grow what the platform does for banks: Build the services Porters performs for banks: Extend the capabilities of our agentic platform such as case handling, customer matching, AI tool integrations, data enrichment, or keeping humans in the loop.

- Deliver features that hold together as a system: Design endpoints, contracts, and interfaces that work together, ensuring features integrate cleanly towards one bigger outcome.

- Ensure your work is reliable: Own design, development, tests, and deployment, so what reaches production is proven to work.

- Wow our customers: You solve for the customer's actual problem, not just the request and measure success by customer outcomes. What would it take for the customer to say “Porters, made my day”.

Your profile 

- Experience: Around 4 years of professional software engineering, with a track record of shipping in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. Regulated industry and/or VC-backed startup experiences are a plus.

- Product thinking: You naturally understand why you’re building something, not just focusing on how to build.

- Quality focus & individual problem solving: Given a clear problem, you reliably produce a clean algorithm, a sensible data model, a well-structured service. You treat tests and observability as part of the feature, and right-size rigor to risk. You are comfortable in a regulated fintech environment where precision matters.

- Technical proficiency: Proficiency in Python is mandatory, along with REST API development, an ORM, and relational databases.

- AI-native: You've worked with, or are eager to work with, LLM/agentic tooling, and understand how to bound probabilistic output with deterministic code.

- Collaboration and eagerness to learn: You thrive on direction, review, and challenge, take feedback well, and want to grow into larger scopes. You are eager to learn every day.

- Going the extra mile: Be part of a high-growth phase, where we move fast and expect focused intensity. 9-to-5 is not the mode we work in, if you want to build something that matters with a team that ships, we are your people.

What We Offer 

- Ownership from day one: Real features running in production at major financial institutions, with the trust to carry them there yourself.

- Founder collaboration: Work directly with founders who have built and scaled fintech and analytics products before.

- We win and lose together as a team: We expect people to leave their comfort zone on a daily basis, however, we work together as a team and support each other at any time.

- Growth: A dedicated development budget, free to use for whatever gives you a level-up.

Culture: Strong focus on a healthy, high-performance team culture, ranging from regular team events and dinners to an inclusive, fast-paced team that grows together.

Our stack 

- Core Backend: Python 3.14, FastAPI, Pydantic, and SQLAlchemy 2.0 in a strict four-layer architecture, exposed as separate internal and external APIs.

- Background processing: Containerized worker services and event-driven AWS Lambda orchestrators for email ingestion, document triaging, and action running.

- AI Integration: AI orchestration deeply integrated into application landscape via AWS Bedrock, e.g., to extract information and drive agentic activity.

- Data & Storage: Per-tenant Aurora MySQL in isolated subnets, S3 for document persistence, and an append-only ledger for auditability.

- Platform: A multi-tenant AWS environment on ECS Fargate with strict per-tenant network and data isolation (VPC, NACLs, WAF), CloudFront + Cognito (Google SSO/JWT) and API Gateway (IAM) at the edge, defined as code in CloudFormation across dev/staging/prod accounts.

- Frontend: React single-page app for the internal workbench.

- Dev Workflow: uv, Ruff, ty, pytest (unit, integration, property-based), Docker, GitHub Actions, and heavy use of Agentic IDEs to accelerate feature shipping.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Join our Data & Analytics team at Crypto Finance, headquartered in the Prime Tower in Zurich. Your primary mandate is pushing the company’s AI strategy forward: identifying use cases across departments, engineering production-grade AI and automation solutions, and helping to build the firm's AI governance practice. You will also contribute to the data platform that underpins Finance, Operations, and Risk reporting, since AI work at our company sits directly on top of that platform. 

This is a hybrid role for someone who is equally comfortable in a stakeholder workshop and an IDE. The work potentially spans AI agents and copilots, deterministic automation, RAG systems, and the data infrastructure they rely on. You will be expected to push back on bad use cases as much as you ship good ones. 

What you will do: 

AI & Automation Engineering 

- Work with stakeholders across Compliance, Trading, Operations, Legal, Sales, and Finance to identify, scope, and prioritize use cases that genuinely move the needle. 
- Engineer production data solutions: Deterministic automations, AI agents, RAG systems over internal documents, structured extraction pipelines. 
- Build the firm's "innovation lab" environment where new use cases can be prototyped and evaluated. 
- Maintain prompt and skill libraries as reusable, version-controlled assets, not as one-off scripts. 
AI Governance and Inventory 

- Maintain the firm-wide inventory of AI systems and use cases, including those built outside D&A. 
- Run the operational side of the company’s AI approval process: documentation, risk classification, model cards, evaluation artifacts. Policy is set at the executive level; you make sure the operational practice meets it. 
- Conduct technical review of new AI initiatives proposed elsewhere in the company; advise on scope, risk, and design choices. 
Data Engineering and Platform 

- Contribute to ELT pipelines on the Dagster + SQLMesh + dlt stack, primarily where AI & automation use cases require new data sources or transformations. 
- Build the data substrate that AI workloads consume; feature views, document indexes, and structured event tables. 
- Maintain infrastructure as code in Git with proper review and deployment standards. 

Requirements 

- 3–6 years of relevant experience. We are flexible on title, could be AI engineer, analytics engineer with AI focus, or data engineer who is pivoted to AI. What matters is shipped work. 
- Demonstrable production experience with LLM applications: at minimum structured extraction with LLMs, and agentic patterns (tool use, multi-step workflows). You can describe what failed and what you learned. 
- Strong Python; comfortable building production ready code, not just notebooks. 
- Working knowledge of evaluation discipline for LLM applications (eval sets, regression tests, observability), conceptual understanding of retrieval, and how to handle hallucination. 
- Familiarity with at least one orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect) and one transformation framework (SQLMesh, dbt). 
- Solid SQL (window functions, joins, query design). 
- Cloud experience, ideally GCP and BigQuery. 
- Genuine curiosity about regulated environments and the discipline they require. 
- Professional proficiency in English (German is a plus). 
- Eligibility to work in Switzerland (Swiss permit or EU/EFTA citizenship). 
Equally important is how you think: 

- You reach for the simplest thing that works. Boring SQL before vector search. Rules before agents. You can explain why. 
- You are comfortable saying "this is not an AI problem" when the right answer is a dashboard, a process fix, or a deterministic script. 
- You can run a stakeholder workshop and write production code in the same week. 
- You take documentation, evaluation, and audit trails seriously, not as overhead. 
Nice to have: 

- Prior exposure to regulated financial services, crypto, or comparable model-risk environments. 
What we are not looking for: 

- "Prompt engineers" with no production experience. 
- Pure data engineers using this posting to pivot into AI without prior LLM work. 
- Strategists or generalist "AI enthusiasts." This is a builder role. 
Benefits 

- Be part of an international, fast-paced blockchain and fintech team led by experienced professionals
- Shape the future of finance while working at the cutting edge of B2B digital asset solutions
- Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture with flat hierarchies
- Take on meaningful responsibility with room for learning and professional growth
- Gain deep industry insights and make a tangible impact
- Join regular company-wide meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and team events
- Enjoy a modern and central workplace in Zurich with top-tier infrastructure

Our culture 

At the heart of our company, we prioritize:

- Innovation and Continuous Learning
- Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing
- Entrepreneurial Spirit and Flat Hierarchies
- Values such as Excellence, Delivery, Ownership, Passion, and Unity

Please note: 

- We do not accept CVs from recruiting or staffing agencies.
- Due to the Swiss/German labor legislation, we can only accept applicants who have the right to work in Switzerland or Germany (are in possession of a Swiss/German work permit or are EU/EFTA citizens). All other applications will not be considered.
- If this is the position for you, and you have a Swiss/German work permit and/or EU citizenship, please send us your complete application, incl. cover letter, CV, and references.

title: Outside Account Manager - Switzerland
description:

- An Education in Sales or a Bachelor’s degree in the field of economics, international business, sales management or a similar field 

- An extensive network within the territory to manage and within the cycling, sports or outdoor industry 

- Experience in a similar position within cycling, sports or outdoor industry 

- Excellent team-player attitude, with strong motivation, drive and communication capabilities 

- Absolutely convinced of the importance of results and timelines 

- Willing to travel frequently and work in a remote capacity 

- Excellent fit with Cannondale sales culture, which means entrepreneurial, dynamic, highly motivated individual with can-do mentality 

- Experience with B2B relationships and C ommercial & Sales success 

- Fluent in both French, German, and English (written & verbal)

- Prior experience working for a global brand and multi-national business 

- A passion for mountain bikes, road bikes and Ebikes , actions sports, and/or outdoor lifestyle 

Some of our Great Benefits:  

- An inspiring position within an international working environment around a sustainable, future-proof mobility product, the bicycle 

- A dynamic, international and challenging role with various internal and external stakeholders

- Hybrid work environment 

- A mix of casual yet professional culture

title: HR & EOR Operations Manager
description:
Part-Time | Switzerland (Remote) | Global EOR & HR Platform | Employed via Swiss Entity 

ABOUT THE CLIENT 

Our client is a fast-growing global HR, payroll, and compliance platform operating across 180+ regions. The company combines technology with owned entities, in-house legal and payroll expertise, transparent pricing, and dedicated human support - helping businesses of all sizes hire talent anywhere in the world.

The company is driven by a constant pursuit of innovation, expanding its product suite to create integrated HR solutions for businesses from fledgling startups to global enterprises.

ABOUT THE ROLE 

We are looking for an HR & EOR Operations Manager to join our Swiss entity on a part-time basis. This is a hands-on operational role - not a purely administrative or advisory position.

As part of the role, you will serve as the named Responsible Person for the Swiss entity under SECO/Zürich personnel leasing law, fulfilling a standing legal obligation tied to our EOR licence. This means you must be genuinely employed, operationally involved, and present in Switzerland - not an external adviser lending a name to a form.

Day-to-day workload is manageable within a 50% FTE, and you will be fully supported by the company's global HR, payroll and compliance teams. Other concurrent work or mandates are welcome, provided they do not interfere with your availability and supervision of the entity's activities.

This role is a strong fit for HR or EOR professionals already freelancing, holding consulting mandates, or looking to add a substantive part-time role to their portfolio.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

- Act as the named Responsible Person for the Swiss entity under Swiss personnel leasing (SECO) law.

- Ensure compliance with Swiss labour-leasing legislation, Swiss employment law, and the staffing industry GAV (minimum wages and equal treatment).

- Maintain documentation required for SECO and cantonal audits and inspections.

- Serve as the primary Swiss contact for SECO and cantonal authorities.

- Oversee HR and employment operations for the Swiss entity - including onboarding, contract controls, and employment matters.

- Support payroll oversight in collaboration with the global payroll team.

- Handle employee and client escalations related to HR and compliance matters.

- Supervise the entity's EOR/personnel leasing activities and ensure they are conducted properly.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

Right to Work in Switzerland - one of the following is required:

- Swiss citizen.

- EU/EFTA national with a current Swiss B or C permit.

- Non-EU/EFTA national with a Swiss C permit (a non-EU/EFTA B permit alone does not qualify).

- EU/EFTA national with a genuine 5-year cross-border G permit.

Education: 

Any completed qualification - EFZ apprenticeship, Matura/Abitur, or university degree in any field.

Experience - either route qualifies: 

Standard route: 

3+ years in one of the following: recruitment or placement, personnel leasing or staffing (including EOR), substantive HR (not admin-only), personnel consulting, or organisational/business consulting. Employment certificates confirming dates, workload percentage and substantive duties are required alongside a CV.

Alternative route: 

3+ years of general professional experience plus a completed, recognised HR qualification with a passed exam (e.g. HRSE or VSH HR Assistant). Course attendance without a final certificate does not count.

Character: 

Clean criminal record, debt-enforcement register and tax history.

Other: 

- Comfortable being named on the Commercial Register with signing authority.

- Willing to disclose other jobs, board mandates or licensed-business responsibilities.

- Genuinely hands-on - purely advisory profiles (external lawyers or accountants with no operational involvement) are not suitable.

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT 

This is a rare opportunity for an experienced HR or EOR professional in Switzerland to take on a meaningful operational role at a global scale without committing to a full-time position.

You will hold a real and recognised legal position within the Swiss entity, with direct contact with SECO and cantonal authorities, while being backed by an experienced international HR, payroll and compliance team.

The 50% structure makes this accessible to consultants, freelancers and professionals looking to add a substantive part-time engagement alongside existing work. International EOR or HR experience is fully valid - experience does not need to be Swiss-based, though familiarity with Swiss employment law and social insurance is an advantage.

The company values a builder mentality - people who want to improve processes, not just maintain them.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT 

- Fully remote within Switzerland.

- Part-time 50% FTE with flexible hours.

- Direct collaboration with the global HR, payroll and compliance teams.

- Meaningful presence in Switzerland required (~50% benchmark) - remote-only offshore oversight does not meet regulatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER 

- Health insurance contributions.

- Share incentives.

- Learning and mentorship opportunities.

- Team offsites and social events.

- 4 weeks of work-from-anywhere per year.

- Other concurrent work or mandates are welcome.

title: Associate Product Owner
description:
TL;DR Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

The problem you'll be solving A corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.

What we're looking for You have personally written the tickets. 
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers. 
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write. 
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.
You write specs worth acting on. 
The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter.
You know what looks good. 
You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually.
You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide. 
No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec.
You want to be coached hard. 
Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast.
You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day. 
We want to see the workflow, not hear it described.
You want the scope to grow. 
The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available.

What you'll do Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday. 
- Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies
- Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting
- Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue
- Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped
- Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients

What you'll be scoping over your first year: 
- Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on.
- Public REST APIs and MCP servers , so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us.
- AI embedded across the product , inside the surfaces people already work in.
- Workflow automation inside the platform , so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself.
You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room.
This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor.

Requirements - 3+ years in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets
- Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation
- Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc
Nice to have: - B2B enterprise SaaS background
- Familiarity with venture clienting, corporate innovation, or startup-scouting workflows
- Notion fluency

Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about the questions you ask about a brief than the answer you land on.

How we hire Straightforward. Respectful of your time. No mystery steps.
- Intro call: a quick chat to see if there's a match
- Interview with the PM, including a brief introduction to the work sample : a spec, PRD, or decision doc where your reasoning is visible, plus examples of problems you've framed
- Interview 
- Offer: if it clicks, we don't wait around

title: Senior Conversion Design Analyst (f/m/d)
description:
Your mission We're looking for a Senior Conversion Design Analyst who decides with evidence. You will frame real user problems based on qualitative and quantitative data, design a part of our product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and analyze the results yourself. 

You will sit inside the product delivery team that focuses on user growth, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it. And you will not be doing it alone: You join a group of Conversion Design Analysts across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards. 

English is our working language. German matters here too: You will be designing flows that German-speaking users read. 

Concretely, you will: - Design experiences grounded in real user needs and real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that are highly usable and intuitive and that earn their place by adding measurable value, not just because we can build them.

- Frame the real problem before solving it. Dig into quantitative and qualitative data until you find the actual question underneath the ask. Then make it explainable and actionable. A well-framed problem is half the battle

- Run the experiment, and read it honestly. Design a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, and saying what you would do differently.

- Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody.

- Direct AI, and spend your judgment where it counts. AI produces a lot of our first-pass design. You will brief it, push back on it, and hold the quality bar, so your own hours go to the thinking a model cannot do. 

- Argue for cutting things. Adding is easy. You will help decide what earns its place and what should be removed, and be willing to make the case for less.

Your profile - You practice product design and analytics. You might come from an analyst background and bring a love of design and design thinking, or vice versa.

- You have technical know-how and experience in setting up and evaluating experiments in an A/B testing tool, constructing the needed dashboards for the problem space you are working on and use our design system tooling.

- With sufficient data literacy, you get your own numbers through SQL query. You work with raw data to dig up insights and spot opportunities, without waiting for someone else to pull it for you.

- You have run experiments end to end: set up the hypothesis, decide on the right metrics to track, design the test variants, analyze the results, decide on how to continue. 

- You have statistical literacy. You don’t need to be able to run R, but you understand what Bayesian vs. frequentist is about and why you do a power analysis before launching an experiment. 

- You care about craft and are attentive to details. You can tell the difference between good enough and actually good and you design experiences people do not have to think about.

- You are fluent with AI tools. This role allows you to have more control and impact through both design and analysis, but to do this well you'll need to leverage (and at times extend) our AI enablement stack

- You present your work clearly, defend your decisions when challenged, and are comfortable in front of a crowd.

- Excellent English skills for working in our international team.

To apply, share a portfolio that shows your work by impact — at least one project walked through end to end: the hypothesis, what you designed, the result, and what you took from it. Show us how you used data to move your thinking forward, and where experimentation shaped what you built. 

Nice to have - Experience with a marketplace, community, classifieds, or other network product. 

- Strong German, or the confidence to design in it with support.

- Experience building or maintaining parts of a design system. 

- Comfortable writing SQL without AI assistance.

- You have basic dbt knowledge.

What we offer - Hybrid work model combining office and remote days 

- A meaningful job – we're creating a great product with real added value for the community

Unser Unternehmen Die bilacon GmbH ist ein Unternehmen der Tentamus Group GmbH und ein bundesweit tätiges akkreditiertes Handelslabor. Im Kundenauftrag führt bilacon schwerpunktmäßig mikrobiologische, chemisch-physikalische und rückstandsanalytische Untersuchungen von Lebensmitteln, Trinkwasser und Tabakwaren durch. Darüber hinaus gehören sensorische Beurteilungen, Kennzeichnungsprüfungen zur Verkehrsfähigkeit sowie Hygieneauditierungen, Schulungen und Beratungen für die Lebensmittelindustrie und den -einzelhandel zu unserem umfassenden Leistungsspektrum.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort engagierte Unterstützung für unsere Probenregistrierung. Werden Sie Teil unseres Prozesses und sichern Sie den reibungslosen Ablauf von der Ankunft der Probe bis zur Analyse. Starten Sie zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als:

Werkstudent/in (m/w/d) in der Probenregistrierung 

Ihre Aufgaben - Übertragung von Kunden- und Produktinformationen in unser Labor-Informations-Management-System (LIMS)
- Erfassung und Registrierung eingehender Lebensmittel- und Futtermittelproben inklusive Beschriften, Wiegen, Etikettieren, Probenvorbereitung und Fotodokumentation
- eigenständiges Anlegen von Untersuchungsparametern als essenzielle Basis für einen reibungslosen Probenfluss und eine termingerechte Bearbeitung
- Abgleich und Bearbeitung von Excel-Tabellen sowie Erledigung allgemeiner administrativer Aufgaben
- Unterstützung in der Kundenkommunikation zur Klärung von Auftragsdetails
- vielseitige Einsätze in angrenzenden Bereichen wie praktische Hilfsarbeiten in verschiedenen Laborbereichen, Unterstützung bei der Probenvorbereitung

Ihr Profil - ein laufendes Studium im naturwissenschaftlichen Bereich (z. B. Lebensmittelchemie, Biotechnologie, Lebensmitteltechnologie oder vergleichbare Studiengänge), das Ihnen wertvolles Hintergrundwissen für die verschiedenen Untersuchungen und Laborabläufe liefert
- Eine pragmatische Hands-on-Mentalität und Berührungsfreiheit im Umgang mit verschiedensten Probenmaterialien (Lebens- und Futtermittel)
- offene Kommunikation und starke Teamfähigkeit 
- Interesse an der Probenregistrierung als zentralem Startpunkt für den gesamten Prozess von der Lebensmittelanalytik bis zum Prüfbericht
- eine sorgfältige, organisierte und analytische Arbeitsweise 
- sicherer Umgang mit dem MS-Office-Paket (insbesondere Excel) sowie idealerweise erste Berührungspunkte mit Datenbanken 
- Bereitschaft für Samstagsarbeit

Wir bieten - wertvolle Praxiserfahrung und spannende Einblicke in ein professionelles Laborumfeld der Lebensmittelanalytik
- faire und attraktive Vergütung
- flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung, die sich gut mit Ihrem Studium vereinbaren lässt
- eine kollegiale und unterstützende Arbeitsatmosphäre in einem motivierten Team

Bei Rückfragen wenden Sie sich bitte an: bilacon GmbH 
Ihr Ansprechpartner ist: Frau Michaelis
An der Industriebahn 5
13088 Berlin

title: (Senior) Sales Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben RYZE Digital ist eine der führenden Agenturgruppen für digitale Unternehmenskommunikation im deutschsprachigen Raum – aufgebaut über eine konsequente Buy-&-Build-Strategie. Wir verbinden strategische Kommunikation, digitales Reporting und Technologie zu einem Leistungsversprechen, das der Markt so nicht kennt: Tech-Driven Corporate Communications.
Zu unseren Kunden zählen börsennotierte Konzerne, größere Mittelständler und Organisationen, für die Kommunikation, Investor Relations und Nachhaltigkeitsberichterstattung geschäftskritisch sind.
Für den gezielten Ausbau unseres Neukundengeschäfts im Geschäftsfeld Corporate Communications & Reporting (CCR) suchen wir eine erfahrene Vertriebspersönlichkeit, die den Markt nicht verwaltet, sondern erschließt.

Deine Rolle 
Du baust unser CCR-Neugeschäft aktiv auf. Du identifizierst relevante Entscheider in Investor Relations, Unternehmenskommunikation und Nachhaltigkeit, eröffnest den Dialog und führst ihn bis zum Abschluss. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Fachbereichen und der Geschäftsführung zusammen, agierst aber eigenverantwortlich – mit dem nötigen Freiraum, deinen Marktzugang selbst zu gestalten.

Deine Aufgaben 
- Neukundenakquise: Du baust eine belastbare Pipeline auf – vom ersten Kontakt über Cold Outreach, Netzwerk und Empfehlungen bis zur qualifizierten Opportunity.
- Buying-Center-Zugang: Du navigierst souverän in komplexen Entscheidungsstrukturen (IR, Comms, ESG, Vorstand) und adressierst die jeweils relevanten Motive.
- Beratender Verkauf: Du verkaufst keine Leistung von der Stange, sondern eine strategische Positionierung – digitales Reporting, Nachhaltigkeitskommunikation und tech-gestützte Kommunikationslösungen.
- Cross-Selling: Du erkennst über den CCR-Einstieg hinaus Potenziale in unseren weiteren Geschäftsfeldern und öffnest diese Türen.
- Abschlussverantwortung: Du führst Angebots- und Vertragsverhandlungen eigenständig bis zum Signing.
- CRM-Disziplin: Du pflegst deine Pipeline sauber in HubSpot und lieferst belastbare Forecasts.
- Als Teamplayer hast Du Lust, im Team das Beste für die Agentur rauszuholen und gemeinsam an den Umsatzzielen zu arbeiten
- Du bist für die Pflege deiner Projekte in unserem CRM-System (HubSpot) verantwortlich und nimmst an unterschiedlichen Jour-Fixe-Terminen teil

Das bringst du mit - Mindestens 5 Jahre Vertriebserfahrung im Lösungs- oder Beratungsverkauf – idealerweise im Agentur-, SaaS-, Reporting- oder Kommunikationsumfeld.
- Nachweisbarer Track Record im Neukundengeschäft mit erklärungsbedürftigen Leistungen und längeren Sales-Zyklen.
- Verständnis für die Welt von Investor Relations, Unternehmenskommunikation und Nachhaltigkeitsberichterstattung (CSRD/ESG) – oder die klare Bereitschaft und Fähigkeit, sich diese schnell zu erschließen.
- Ausgeprägte Hunter-Mentalität: Eigenantrieb, Abschlussorientierung und hohe Frustrationstoleranz.
- Souveränes Auftreten auf Entscheider- und Vorstandsebene.
- Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, gutes Englisch.

Das bieten wir dir - Ein verkaufbares Alleinstellungsmerkmal: Eine echte Marktposition statt eines austauschbaren Leistungskatalogs – mit Rückenwind durch regulatorische Treiber wie die CSRD.
- Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust dein Geschäft auf, statt eine bestehende Struktur zu verwalten – mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung.
- Attraktives Vergütungsmodell: Wettbewerbsfähiges Fixum plus leistungsstarke, ungedeckelte variable Komponente.
- Flexibilität: Mobiles Arbeiten und moderne Arbeitsbedingungen an unseren Standorten.
- Eine Gruppe im Aufbau: Eine wachsende, akquisitionsgetriebene Plattform mit klarer Ambition zur Marktführerschaft.

Klingt nach dir? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – gern formlos, mit deinem Track Record und einem Satz dazu, warum gerade du unser CCR-Neugeschäft nach vorn bringst.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE – Kubernetes & Hybrid Cloud (m/f/d)
description:
Introduction At a glance 

- Location & work model : Berlin, hybrid 
- Tech stack: Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester ( KubeVirt ), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph 
- Team: A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SRE we're hiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware 
- Process: Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team 
- Languages: Fluent English required; German is a plus, not a must 
Why this role is special 

Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time. 

Your first 90 days

- Help build our custom Kubernetes operator (CRDs) that makes stateful search clusters declarative, self-healing and safely upgradable – and roll out the auto-scaling (HPA/VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) today's architecture makes hard

Your profile Must-haves: 
- Kubernetes in production – built, not just used : you've set up and maintained clusters on your own servers (e.g. kubeadm , RKE2, k3s) and know cluster lifecycle and upgrades – managed-only experience isn't enough for this role

- Real-world experience in software development and/or engineering operations for consumer products and services; B.S. in a technology-focused field is helpful.

- Build relationships with executive and senior stakeholders

- Lead commercial negotiations and enterprise procurement processes

title: Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
description:
What we do At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.

Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.

Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.

After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.

If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.

What you'll be doing You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.

You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.

We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.

Own the wealth product area end to end 

- Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
- Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
- Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
- Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it
Turn the data into something users act on 

- Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
- Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
- Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway
Own the numbers 

- Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
- Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
- Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you

What we are looking for You might be a fit if: 

- You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
- You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
- You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. 
- You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. 
- Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
- You're fluent in English; German is a plus
- You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany
That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. 

Strong plus if you have: 

- PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
- Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
- Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
- Subscription and paywall experimentation
- Experience mentoring or coaching other product managers
- Your own portfolio, and opinions about it
If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply. We'd rather read your application than guess.

Work authorisation 

This role requires an existing right to work in Germany. We're not able to sponsor visas or support relocation for this position, so we can only consider candidates who already hold German or EU work authorisation, or who can obtain it independently. We'd rather tell you now than after four conversations.

What the first six months look like 

- Month 1: you know the data model, the aggregation layer and its technology behind it. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. You've written down the three things you think are most wrong with the product today
- Months 2 to 3: a written, agreed area strategy with a prioritised roadmap, a primary metric with a baseline, and, clear metrics that you will be monitoring and optimizing along the way
- Months 3 to 4: the first thing you scoped is live to a user segment, with a read on the primary metric, and with quality measurement behind it if it involves generated output
- Months 5 to 6: two or three shipped iterations with measured results, including the ones that didn't work, a quality bar the team applies without you in the room, and at least one junior product manager who's visibly better at their job because of you
You won't be measured on shipping volume. You'll be measured on whether your area got measurably more useful and more trustworthy.

Why join getquin? Why join getquin? 

We're a fast-growing B2C fintech, and here, your work has real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of your domain, ship features end-to-end, and help shape the direction of a product used across Europe. We value initiative, ownership and creativity, not layers of process.

Three things that are specifically true of this role:

- Wealth management is ripe for disruption. Following digitalisation waves of banking and brokerage services, we are leading those efforts across the next big topic for private individuals: better understand and optimize your wealth
- The data asset is genuinely rare. Aggregated cross-institution wealth for half a million people, with over +€25bn in connected assets. Trade Republic sees its own platform. N26 sees the current account. Nobody else in Europe sees the whole picture, which means there are product questions you can only answer here
- You'll own the area, not a slice of it. At our size the decisions are yours
Ready to build something meaningful? Then join us at the forefront of making wealth building accessible to everyone.

How we hire 

Five conversations, typically three to four weeks from first call to decision. We tell you where you stand after every step, and we respond within seven days at every stage.

- Recruiter screen, 30 min, video. Role, scope, the salary band, hybrid expectation, notice period, work authorisation. No trick questions
- Hiring manager, 60 min, video. Your product area ownership, the outcome you drove, and your depth in the wealth domain. This is the first real fit conversation, in both directions
- Product case, take home. We give you a real getquin problem on aggregated wealth data and work through it together. We know you already have a job, hence we do not impose an in-person case during working hours
- Cross-functional panel, 2 x 30 min, in our Berlin office. Cover in more depth your case study and deep dive further in your understanding of product metrics and approach to product development. Usually in person in our office.
- Close conversation, 30 min. Team fit, how you like to work, and whatever is still open, including your questions for a founder
Along the last part we will be making reference checks, but only with former employers. Once we have this, we will make you a formal offer. 

The whole loop runs in English. Tell us if you need any adjustment to the process, whether timing, format or accessibility, and we'll make it. You don't need to explain why.

Your mission - The focus is on further developing our Odoo platform—which includes approximately 25 in-house modules—and upgrading it to the target version. In doing so, you’ll rely on an upgrade-friendly architecture based on inheritance rather than modifications to the Odoo core

- For you, Odoo is not just a configuration tool: ORM, inheritance, Views, and QWeb, access rights, and cron jobs are all part of your skill set—ideally complemented by Odoo E-Commerce
- You confidently analyze existing software, refactor it strategically, and further develop it with a focus on quality, maintainability, and stability

title: Product Engineer (Backend/AI) @Briink
description:
What we do At Briink , we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. We work with the world’s largest climate organizations, including CDP and PRI, and multinational companies such as Bayer, Siemens, Commerzbank, E.ON, and Heidelberg Materials.

Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide.

We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good.

Application requirement: Intro video
As part of your application, please submit a short intro video (max 2 minutes) answering:
- Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role. 
- Why you’re excited about owning and shipping AI-powered products at Briink. 
- Why Briink’s sustainability mission resonates with you.
Upload your video using this form (YouTube unlisted, Loom, or any other solution is fine). We do this to get a better sense of candidates before continuing the process. Any application without a video will not be considered ;)

title: Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Our Opportunity Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate.

Your Mission As a Senior Backend Engineer, you own the systems behind our platform: the GraphQL API, the relational data model, the background processing that turns customer documents and spreadsheets into structured data, and the permission model that lets a single owner and a bank with hundreds of portfolios use the same product. Most of your work runs from schema design all the way to the resolver.
You partner with product, design and other engineers to make sure we build what matters - not just what you have been told to do. You take real responsibility for production: when something is slow, you find out why, whether the answer is a bad query, application code or the infrastructure underneath.
You also help us make AI reliable in production. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo.
Our company size of ~40 people ensures that the best idea wins and political discussions are kept aside. And every line of code helps to improve the carbon footprint of real estate properties.

Tech stack: TypeScript (NestJS backend, React frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (multiple databases incl. PostGIS), queue-based job processing, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), IaC, Claude but all agents welcome

What you'll own - Build features across our Hasura GraphQL API, NestJS and Postgres. From schema design to resolver.
- Model complex real estate and ESG domains in relational schemas. We run several Postgres databases side by side (one of them geospatial), and schema decisions here have consequences but also positive impact.
- Own background processing: Excel imports, document extraction, long-running analysis jobs, 3D and image processing. Queues, retries, jobs that spawn other jobs - and figuring out what to do when step 3 of 7 fails at 2am.
- Develop our permission model. Customers range from a single owner to enterprises with organization/portfolio/building-level access.
- Integrate LLMs into backend workflows - especially document and data extraction - and make them reliable, verifyable and testable.
- Debug production. Navigate Grafana dashboards and traces to find out why something is slow or failing, whether in the app, the CI/build pipeline or the infrastructure.
- Spot overgrown or overly complex parts of the codebase and simplify them without being asked. Paying down complexity is part of the job.

What success looks like - You have shipped features end-to-end across schema, API and background processing that our customers actively use.
- Our async processing (imports, extraction, analysis jobs) is measurably more robust: fewer silent failures, clear retry and recovery paths, and observability that tells us what broke and why.
- You have taken ownership of at least one core area e.g. the permission model, the job orchestration layer or the LLM extraction pipeline and are the person the team goes to for it.
- You have raised the bar on testing and developer experience in the backend, and other engineers ship faster because of you.
- You are a trusted sparring partner for product and the team when we decide what to build and how.

What it takes - You're strong with Postgres. Schema design comes naturally, you can read a query plan, and you know when the ORM is lying to you. Geospatial experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
- You're fluent in typed backend TypeScript. We work in NestJS and GraphQL every day; if your experience is in a comparable stack, that's fine, you'll pick it up fast.
- You've built real queue-based processing. You designed workers, dealt with retries and partial failures, orchestrated multi-step workflows.
- You've designed or worked with authorization for a multi-tenant product and know where it might get hairy.
- You'd rather have one integration test that hits a real database schema than ten unit tests mocking everything. You write the test that catches the broken migration.
- You treat production as a debuggable system. You can navigate dashboards and traces to figure out why something is slow, and you don't treat infrastructure as someone else's problem.
- You communicate clearly - with engineers, product and, when needed, directly with customers.
- You speak German at C1 level or better and English fluently. Our customers are German banks and asset managers, and you will talk to them.
Bonus: - AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) and IaC. 

- LLMs in production, especially document or data extraction and making it reliable for actual user workflows. 

- Data pipeline work: staged, reproducible processing, dataset versioning. 

- Mentoring or leading engineers, or wanting to grow into it. 

- Debugging tooling and build issues, not just application code. Our toolchain moves fast and is occasionally non-standard. 

Why Predium? - Stage: ~40 people, well-funded, on the way to defining the category. Early enough that a lot still needs to be built. Yes, it's messy sometimes - that's the whole point. If you're looking for a job with a finished playbook, this isn't the right fit.

- Impact: You're not cog #100 in some company. What you build here runs in production and is what customers rely on every day. Your contribution shows up directly, in revenue and in the product.

- Ownership: We don't manage your time, we measure your results. You get responsibility and freedom - and the expectation that you'll use both.

- Compensation: Competitive salary, bonus, and equity. We want you to share in the success you help create.

- Team: Office-first in Munich's Werksviertel, 4 days/week.

- Produktion briefen . Für Film, Design und größere Produktionen arbeitest du mit Freelancern und Spezialisten. Du briefst sie, beurteilst, was zurückkommt, und hältst die Marke über alle Kanäle konsistent.
